Handheld tracking pushes in behind the thief, then trucks to the policewoman's profile, strong sense of speed.

prompt_zh: 旧楼楼梯间俯拍，镜头从螺旋楼梯中央向下看：主角一手撑扶手两级两级往下跳，追兵在上面三层探头张望；切近景，主角喘着气背贴墙，听到脚步声逼近。

The doors shut; he grabs the pole, gasping, and looks up straight into a familiar pair of eyes.

prompt_zh: 写追逐时固定三件事：①方向（从画面左向右跑，全程不反向，避免越轴）；②障碍物（每 2 秒一个：人群、箱子、门、栏杆）；③距离变化（追兵从远到近，或主角拉开距离）。示例：两人始终从左向右奔跑，追兵每过一个障碍就近一步。
prompt_en: Lock three things in a chase: (1) direction—run left to right throughout, never reverse, to avoid crossing the line; (2) obstacles—one every two seconds: crowd, crates, a door, a railing; (3) changing distance—pursuer closing in, or the hero pulling away. Example: both always run left to right; the pursuer gains a step at each obstacle.

prompt_zh: 震惊不要只写「很震惊」：①瞳孔放大、动作停住（0.5 秒）；②后退半步、手里的东西滑落；③嘴唇微张却说不出话，呼吸急促。镜头从中景快速推到特写。

prompt_zh: 黑暗走廊，她背贴墙壁，一手捂住嘴防止发出声音，胸口剧烈起伏，眼睛随着门外的脚步声左右移动；一滴冷汗从鬓角滑下。低调光，近景。

prompt_en: Airport arrivals. Holding a name sign, he waits until the last passenger walks out; his arm slowly lowers and the sign creases. He turns silently and leaves, his back shrinking into the crowd. Wide locked-off shot.

prompt_en: Eyes do more than lines: (1) evasive—gaze drops away, can't hold eye contact; (2) provocative—chin slightly raised, lids half-lowered, direct stare; (3) heartache—brows slightly knit, gaze resting on the other's injury; (4) suspicious—narrowed eyes, head tilted; (5) resolute—steady unblinking gaze, then slowly looks away.

prompt_zh: 微表情要配特写或大特写，并只写 1–2 个面部变化：眉（蹙、挑）、眼（眯、睁、眨、泛红）、嘴（抿、颤、上扬一侧）、喉咙（吞咽）、鼻（皱、翕动）。加「表情变化细微自然，不夸张」避免模型做成鬼脸。

prompt_zh: 清晨窗帘缝透进一道阳光。闹钟响起，她从被子里伸出一只手摸索着按掉，停顿两秒后猛地坐起，揉着眼睛看向手机，表情瞬间清醒——「迟到了」。中景，暖色晨光。
prompt_en: A shaft of morning sun through a gap in the curtains. The alarm rings; her hand gropes out from under the duvet and switches it off. Two seconds later she bolts upright, rubs her eyes, looks at her phone and is instantly awake—she's late. Medium shot, warm morning light.

prompt_zh: 小饭馆后厨，厨师左手握锅柄连续颠勺三下，炒饭在空中翻起又落回锅里，火苗从锅边窜起；右手顺势撒一把葱花。侧面中近景，油烟在灯下翻滚。
prompt_en: Small restaurant kitchen. The cook flips the wok three times with his left hand, fried rice tumbling in the air and landing back in the pan as flames leap from the rim; his right hand tosses in a pinch of scallions. Side medium close-up, smoke rolling under the lamp.

prompt_zh: 早高峰地铁车厢，男主一手高举咖啡杯一手抓吊环，被人群挤得身体左右摇晃，咖啡在杯中晃出小波纹却始终没洒；他松了口气，露出一个苦笑。手持近景。
prompt_en: Packed rush-hour train. The lead holds a coffee cup high in one hand and grips a strap with the other, swaying as the crowd pushes; the coffee ripples but never spills. He exhales and gives a wry smile. Handheld close shot.

prompt_zh: 玄关全身镜前，他双手捏住衬衫领口向下拉平，抬下巴扣上第一颗扣子，对着镜子深吸一口气，拿起钥匙推门而出。镜中反打，节奏利落。
prompt_en: In front of the hallway mirror, he pinches his shirt collar and smooths it down, lifts his chin to fasten the top button, takes a deep breath at his reflection, grabs the keys and walks out. Mirror reverse shot, brisk rhythm.

title.en: Closing the umbrella at the door

prompt_zh: 咖啡店门口，女孩在屋檐下收伞，抖两下甩掉雨水，伞面水珠飞溅；她推门进去，门上风铃晃动，热气让她的眼镜瞬间起雾。
prompt_en: At a café entrance, a girl folds her umbrella under the awning and shakes it twice, droplets flying; she pushes the door open, the chime swinging, and the warm air instantly fogs her glasses.

prompt_zh: 深夜空荡的办公室，只剩一盏台灯。她停下敲键盘的手，双臂向上伸懒腰，脖子左右转动发出轻响，然后看了一眼窗外城市的灯，叹口气继续工作。广角远景到近景。
prompt_en: Empty office late at night, a single desk lamp on. She stops typing, stretches both arms overhead, rolls her neck side to side with a soft crack, glances at the city lights outside, sighs and goes back to work. Wide to close.

prompt_zh: 卧室地上摊开的行李箱，她把叠好的衣服一件件放进去，拿起一张合照时动作停住，看了几秒，把照片反扣在床上，用力合上箱子拉上拉链。俯拍接近景。
prompt_en: An open suitcase on the bedroom floor. She places folded clothes in one by one, pauses when she picks up a framed couple photo, looks at it for a few seconds, lays it face-down on the bed, then slams the suitcase shut and zips it. Overhead then close.

prompt_zh: 厨房地板，橘猫绕着主人的脚踝蹭来蹭去；主人蹲下把猫粮倒进碗里，猫立刻低头吃起来，尾巴竖起轻轻抖动。低机位贴地拍摄，暖色。
prompt_en: Kitchen floor; an orange cat weaves around its owner's ankles. The owner crouches and pours kibble into the bowl; the cat immediately dives in, tail upright and quivering. Low ground-level camera, warm tones.

prompt_zh: 台灯下，钢笔在信纸上写完最后一行，笔尖停顿留下一个墨点；她把信折成三折放进信封，舌尖不碰，用手指沾水抹过封口压平。微距特写，暖光。
prompt_en: Under a desk lamp, a fountain pen finishes the last line, the nib pausing to leave a small ink dot. She folds the letter in thirds, slides it into an envelope, dampens the flap with a fingertip and presses it flat. Macro close-up, warm light.

prompt_zh: 「走」要写出状态：①疲惫——拖着脚步、肩膀下垂；②自信——步幅大、抬头挺胸、手臂自然摆动；③心虚——贴着墙走、频频回头；④急切——小跑几步又放慢；⑤失魂——目光空洞、被路人撞到也没反应。
prompt_en: Write the state into the walk: (1) exhausted—dragging feet, shoulders slumped; (2) confident—long strides, chin up, arms swinging; (3) guilty—hugging the wall, glancing back; (4) anxious—breaking into a jog then slowing; (5) dazed—vacant eyes, not reacting when a passer-by bumps into her.

prompt_zh: 同一个「坐下」，不同潜台词：霸总——解开西装扣子，向后靠进沙发，双腿交叠；面试者——只坐椅子前三分之一，双手放在膝上；叛逆少年——把椅子反过来跨坐，手臂搭在椅背上。
prompt_en: One "sit down," different subtext: the CEO unbuttons his jacket, leans back into the sofa and crosses his legs; the interviewee perches on the front third of the chair, hands on knees; the rebellious teen flips the chair around and straddles it, arms draped over the backrest.

title.en: Opening the door to a surprise

prompt_zh: 她拧开家门钥匙，推门的手忽然停住——客厅灯亮着，她出门前明明关了。镜头从她身后越过肩膀看向客厅，慢慢推进，她屏住呼吸放下包。
prompt_en: She turns the key and starts to push the door, then her hand stops—the living-room light is on, though she switched it off before leaving. Over-the-shoulder from behind her looking into the room, slow push-in; she holds her breath and sets down her bag.

prompt_zh: 梳妆台镜前，女主拿起口红，对着镜子缓缓涂上正红色，抿一下嘴唇，再把散落的头发挽起；镜中她的眼神从疲惫变得锋利。镜面反打近景，暖色化妆灯。
prompt_en: At the vanity mirror, the heroine picks up a lipstick and slowly applies a true red, presses her lips together, then pins up her loose hair; in the mirror her eyes shift from tired to sharp. Mirror reverse close shot, warm vanity lights.

prompt_zh: 古装武侠，竹林空地。镜头1（0-2秒）：黑衣刺客持刀从右侧劈下，白衣女侠左臂上抬格挡，刀背擦过护腕迸出火星；镜头2（2-4秒）：她顺势转腰卸力，右掌推向刺客胸口，刺客后退三步，脚下竹叶飞散；镜头3（4-5秒）：她收掌站定，衣摆缓缓落下。中景侧拍，动作清晰，无快速剪切。
prompt_en: Wuxia, bamboo-forest clearing. Shot 1 (0-2s): a black-clad assassin slashes down from the right; the swordswoman in white raises her left forearm to block, the blade's spine scraping her bracer in a spray of sparks. Shot 2 (2-4s): she twists her waist to redirect the force and drives her right palm into his chest; he staggers back three steps, bamboo leaves scattering. Shot 3 (4-5s): she withdraws her palm and settles; her robe hem drifts down. Medium side angle, clear readable choreography, no rapid cuts.

prompt_zh: 地下拳馆，顶光。拳手左脚前踏一步打出两记快速刺拳，紧接着转胯发力打出右勾拳，命中沙袋的瞬间切入 0.5 倍慢动作：沙袋凹陷、汗珠从拳套上甩出、链条摇晃。低机位中近景，轻微手持晃动。
prompt_en: Underground boxing gym, top light. The boxer steps in with the left foot and fires two quick jabs, then rotates the hips into a right hook; at impact on the heavy bag the shot drops to 0.5x slow motion: the bag dents, sweat flicks off the glove, the chain sways. Low-angle medium close-up, slight handheld shake.

prompt_zh: 雨夜小巷。穿皮夹克的男人用双手猛推对方胸口，对方踉跄后退撞上垃圾桶，桶盖哐当落地；他稳住身体，抹一把脸上的雨水，攥紧拳头向前一步。写实风格，无血腥，手持跟拍，霓虹反光。
prompt_en: Rainy alley at night. A man in a leather jacket shoves the other man hard in the chest with both hands; the other stumbles back into a trash bin, its lid clattering to the ground. He steadies himself, wipes rain from his face, clenches his fists and steps forward. Realistic, no gore, handheld follow, neon reflections.

prompt_zh: 特写：右手拇指顶开剑格，剑身一寸寸滑出剑鞘，刃口反射出一道冷光扫过人物眼睛；切中景：他手腕一翻，剑尖斜指地面，衣袖被风吹起。慢节奏，金属摩擦声。
prompt_en: Close-up: the right thumb pushes the guard open and the blade slides out of the scabbard inch by inch, its edge throwing a cold glint across his eyes. Cut to medium: he flips his wrist, the tip angled toward the ground, sleeve lifting in the wind. Slow tempo, metallic scrape.

prompt_zh: 办公室走廊。男人从背后抓住女主右肩，她立刻左手扣住他的手腕，转身下潜，右肘压住他的手肘关节，将他按到墙上；他脸贴墙面动弹不得。动作干净利落，全景接中景，无血腥。
prompt_en: Office corridor. A man grabs the heroine's right shoulder from behind; she clamps his wrist with her left hand, turns and ducks, presses her right elbow onto his elbow joint and pins him against the wall, his cheek flat on the surface. Clean, efficient choreography, wide to medium, no gore.

prompt_zh: 天台黄昏。武者助跑两步起跳，身体在空中横展，右腿侧踢而出，动作最高点慢放 1 秒，衣角猎猎作响；落地时单膝着地，地面积水溅起。侧面全景，逆光剪影。
prompt_en: Rooftop at dusk. The fighter takes two running steps and leaps, body extending horizontally in the air as the right leg shoots out in a side kick; at the apex the motion slows for one second, clothes snapping in the wind. He lands on one knee, puddle water splashing up. Wide side angle, backlit silhouette.

prompt_zh: 一镜到底，镜头环绕主角缓慢旋转。四名打手依次从前、左、后、右扑上：主角侧身躲过第一拳、肘击第二人、低扫第三人小腿、抓住第四人手臂借力摔出。每次攻击间隔约 1 秒，节奏清晰，人物位置不重叠，无血腥。
prompt_en: Single continuous take, camera slowly orbiting the hero. Four thugs attack in order from front, left, back and right: he sidesteps the first punch, elbows the second, sweeps the third's shin, grabs the fourth's arm and throws him using his momentum. About one second between attacks, clear rhythm, no overlapping bodies, no gore.

prompt_zh: 清晨公园薄雾中，两位老人搭手推手：双掌相贴画圆，一推一化，重心在前后脚之间缓慢移动；年轻挑战者猛力一推，老人腰胯一转将力卸开，对方向前扑空两步。慢节奏，中景平视。
prompt_en: Misty park at dawn. Two elders practice push hands, palms touching and tracing circles, pushing and yielding as weight shifts slowly between front and back foot. A young challenger shoves hard; the elder turns his waist and hips to dissolve the force and the challenger lunges two steps into empty air. Slow tempo, medium eye-level.

prompt_zh: 豪宅客厅。贵妇扬手扇向女主，女主头也不回地抬手在半空扣住她的手腕，动作停顿一拍；镜头推到贵妇震惊的脸，再切女主冷静抬眼。慢动作 0.5 倍用于扣腕瞬间，之后恢复正常速度。
prompt_en: Mansion living room. The rich matriarch swings a slap at the heroine, who without turning her head raises a hand and catches the wrist mid-air; the motion holds for a beat. Push in on the matriarch's shocked face, then cut to the heroine calmly lifting her gaze. 0.5x slow motion on the catch, normal speed after.

prompt_zh: 寺院石阶。武僧双手握棍中段，在身前快速舞出 8 字花，棍梢带出运动模糊，最后一记竖劈砸在石阶上，碎石跳起；他收棍立于身侧，呼吸起伏。中景平视，晨光侧逆。
prompt_en: Temple stone steps. A warrior monk grips the staff at the middle and spins rapid figure-eights in front of him, the tips trailing motion blur; a final vertical strike cracks onto the step, chips leaping up. He brings the staff upright at his side, chest rising with breath. Medium eye-level, morning side-backlight.

title.zh: 动作安全写法：受击不写伤口

prompt_zh: 受击反应只写身体反馈，不写伤口和血：「被击中后身体向后弓起、踉跄两步、单手捂住肋侧、表情因疼痛扭曲」。这样既有冲击力，也更容易通过平台审核。
prompt_en: Describe hit reactions through body feedback, not wounds or blood: "after the hit his body arches back, he staggers two steps, clutches his ribs with one hand, face twisting in pain." It keeps the impact and passes platform moderation more easily.

prompt_zh: 夜色中两把长刀正面相撞，刀刃交叉处迸出一簇火星，两人角力僵持，刀身微微颤抖，镜头从刀刃交点特写拉到两人咬牙对视的中景。冷蓝月光，火星暖色。
prompt_en: Two long blades clash head-on at night, a burst of sparks at the crossing point; the fighters strain against each other, steel trembling, as the camera pulls from a close-up of the crossed edges to a medium shot of them glaring through gritted teeth. Cool blue moonlight, warm sparks.

prompt_zh: 被逼到墙角的女主右脚蹬墙两步向上跑，身体后空翻越过对手头顶，落在他身后，顺势一记手刀切向他颈侧，对手跪倒。慢动作用于翻越最高点，无血腥。
prompt_en: Cornered, the heroine runs two steps up the wall with her right foot, backflips over her opponent's head, lands behind him and follows with a knife-hand strike to the side of his neck; he drops to his knees. Slow motion at the top of the flip, no gore.

prompt_zh: 【主体+外观】+【动作动词（具体到身体部位）】+【节奏/速度】+【力度与重心变化】+【与环境/道具的物理交互】+【镜头景别与运镜】+【时长分段】。示例：一名穿灰色连帽衫的年轻男子，右脚蹬地、身体前倾，三步加速冲向镜头，第三步时左肩撞开半掩的铁门，铁门反弹发出闷响；中景低机位跟拍，0-2秒加速，2-3秒撞门瞬间轻微慢放。
prompt_en: [Subject + look] + [action verb tied to a body part] + [tempo/speed] + [force and weight shift] + [physical interaction with environment/props] + [shot size and camera move] + [time segments]. Example: A young man in a grey hoodie pushes off with his right foot, leans forward and accelerates in three strides toward the camera; on the third stride his left shoulder bursts through a half-open steel door that rebounds with a dull clang. Medium low-angle tracking shot; 0-2s acceleration, 2-3s slight slow motion on the impact.

prompt_zh: 每个镜头只写一个主要动作，并写清起点和终点状态。错误：「她走进房间、坐下、打开电脑、哭了起来」。正确：镜头1（0-3秒）：她推门走进昏暗的房间，在门口停住；镜头2（3-6秒）：她坐在桌前，盯着屏幕，下唇轻轻发抖，一滴眼泪滑下。
prompt_en: Give each shot one main action and state its start and end pose. Weak: "She walks in, sits down, opens the laptop and starts crying." Better: Shot 1 (0-3s): she pushes the door open into a dim room and stops at the threshold. Shot 2 (3-6s): she sits at the desk staring at the screen, lower lip trembling, a single tear sliding down.

title.zh: 节奏词速查：快慢与停顿

prompt_zh: 快：猛地、骤然、一把、疾步、甩、弹起、连续三下；慢：缓缓、一点点、迟疑地、慢动作、拖着脚步；停顿：动作停在半空、定格一拍、屏住呼吸、手悬在门把上方。写法示例：她猛地转身，抬起的手停在半空一拍，然后缓缓放下。
prompt_en: Fast: suddenly, snaps, whips, darts, springs up, three rapid strikes. Slow: slowly, inch by inch, hesitantly, slow motion, drags her feet. Pause: freezes mid-air, holds for a beat, breath held, hand hovering above the doorknob. Example: She spins around suddenly, her raised hand freezing mid-air for a beat before slowly lowering.

title.zh: 写物理反馈让动作可信

prompt_zh: 动作后面接「环境的反应」，模型更容易生成可信的运动：脚步→水花溅起/落叶被踢散；挥拳→衣袖甩动、汗珠飞出；摔倒→桌上的杯子震倒、灰尘扬起；关门→门框震动、墙上相框轻晃。示例：他一拳砸在木桌上，桌面的茶杯跳起又落下，茶水溅出一圈。
prompt_en: Follow the action with the environment's reaction so the motion reads as real: footsteps → water splashes or leaves scatter; punch → sleeve whips, sweat flies; fall → a cup on the table tips over, dust rises; door slam → frame shudders, a picture frame rattles. Example: He slams his fist on the wooden table; the teacup jumps and lands, tea splashing in a ring.

title.en: Break the action into body parts

prompt_zh: 把一个笼统动作拆成「下肢→躯干→上肢→头部→眼神」的顺序。笼统：「他很生气地站起来」。拆解：他双手撑住桌沿，膝盖一挺站起，椅子向后滑开；肩膀耸起，下颌收紧，眼睛死死盯住对面的人。
prompt_en: Split a vague action into legs → torso → arms → head → eyes. Vague: "He stands up angrily." Broken down: He plants both hands on the table edge, straightens his knees and rises, chair skidding back; shoulders lift, jaw tightens, eyes locked on the person opposite.

prompt_zh: 微距：一只手提起紫砂壶，壶嘴倾斜，细细的茶汤注入白瓷杯，茶面升起热气；倒到七分满时手腕轻轻一收，壶嘴不滴水。侧逆光，背景暗。
prompt_en: Macro: a hand lifts a clay teapot and tilts the spout, a thin stream of tea filling a white porcelain cup as steam rises; at seven-tenths full the wrist pulls back gently and the spout doesn't drip. Side-backlight, dark background.

prompt_zh: 特写：钢笔笔尖悬在签名栏上方停顿两秒，手指微微发抖，然后果断落笔，流畅签下名字，最后一笔重重一顿。浅景深，纸张纹理清晰。
prompt_en: Close-up: the pen nib hovers over the signature line for two seconds, fingers trembling slightly, then comes down decisively and signs in one smooth motion, pressing hard on the final stroke. Shallow depth of field, paper texture visible.

prompt_zh: 特写：她的右手捏住左手无名指上的婚戒，慢慢转了两圈，用力摘下，放在桌上推向对面；戒指在桌面上滑动后停住。冷色侧光。
prompt_en: Close-up: her right hand grips the wedding ring on her left ring finger, twists it twice, pulls it off and slides it across the table; the ring glides and stops. Cool side light.

prompt_zh: 手机屏幕特写：拇指快速打出一行字，停住，删除，再打，再删；最后只发出一个「好」。屏幕光映在脸上，近景切换。
prompt_en: Phone screen close-up: a thumb quickly types a line, stops, deletes it, types again, deletes again, and finally sends just "OK." Screen glow on the face, cutting between close shots.

prompt_zh: 双手捏住一张合照的上沿，从中间缓缓撕开，裂口正好把两个人分开；她把两半叠起再撕一次，碎片从指间落下，慢动作。
prompt_en: Two hands pinch the top edge of a couple photo and slowly tear it down the middle, the rip separating the two people; she stacks the halves and tears again, pieces falling from her fingers in slow motion.

prompt_zh: 漆黑中一根火柴划过火柴盒，火光「嗤」地亮起，照亮一只手和半张脸；手掌拢住火苗点燃桌上的蜡烛，火柴被轻轻甩灭，一缕青烟升起。

prompt_zh: 玄关，她踮起脚帮他整理歪掉的领带，双手把领结推正，再轻轻拍了两下他的胸口；他低头看着她笑。近景，暖光。

prompt_en: An old man's wrinkled hands turn the pages of an old album and stop at a yellowed black-and-white photo; his forefinger gently strokes a face in the picture. Push into the photo, transitioning into a flashback.

prompt_zh: 手部最容易出现多指、融合。写法：①明确是左手还是右手；②每次只写一个手部动作；③给出道具的材质和大小（「一支细长的黑色钢笔」）；④加约束「五指清晰、手部结构正确」；⑤优先用特写，背景简单。

prompt_en: The number on the screen hits the target; the four-person team jumps out of their chairs at once, high-fiving in pairs, someone tossing papers into the air that drift slowly down. Medium shot, bright office.

prompt_zh: 醉汉伸手要抓女主手腕，男主从侧面一步跨到她身前，抬手挡开对方的手，把她护在身后；女主抓着他的衣角，抬头看他的侧脸。中景转过肩镜头。
prompt_en: A drunk reaches for the heroine's wrist; the hero steps in from the side, knocks the hand away and shields her behind him. She grips the hem of his jacket and looks up at his profile. Medium shot to over-the-shoulder.

prompt_zh: 多人镜头先写站位（谁在左、谁在右、谁在前景），再写谁先动、谁反应；每人用不同的服装颜色或外形区分（「穿红裙的女人」「戴眼镜的男人」），避免模型混淆身份。人数尽量不超过 4 人。

Distinguish each person by costume color or look ("the woman in the red dress," "the man with glasses") so the model doesn't swap identities. Keep it to four people or fewer.

prompt_en: A sudden downpour; he holds his jacket open over both their heads and they run across the street laughing, ducking under a convenience store awning, cracking up and shaking off the rain. Medium tracking shot, night streetlights, modest clothing.

prompt_en: Outdoor court at dusk. The ball handler dribbles once between his legs, crosses over to shake the defender and takes two steps into a layup, banking it in off the glass; slow motion at the apex, net swaying. Low-angle tracking.

prompt_zh: 雨中球场，传中球飞来，前锋侧身倒地凌空抽射，脚背击球瞬间水珠四溅、定格半秒，球直挂球门死角。侧面中景接球门后方视角。
prompt_en: Rain-soaked pitch. A cross sails in; the striker falls sideways into a volley, water spraying at the moment of contact with a half-second freeze, the ball flying into the top corner. Side medium shot, then a view from behind the goal.

prompt_zh: 泳池出发台，哨声响起，运动员蹬台跃出，身体在空中拉成直线，指尖先入水几乎不溅水花；镜头切到水下，气泡沿身体拖出一条白线。
prompt_en: Starting block, the whistle sounds; the swimmer springs off, body stretched straight in the air, fingertips entering the water with barely a splash. Cut underwater: bubbles trail along the body in a white line.

prompt_zh: 体育馆，运动员后撤两步起跳，身体反弓蓄力，挥拍跳杀，拍面击球瞬间镜头 180 度快速环绕，羽毛球拖出一道白线落地。
prompt_en: Indoor arena. The player steps back twice and jumps, arching the body to load power, then swings into a jump smash; at contact the camera whips 180 degrees around her, the shuttle trailing a white line to the floor.

prompt_zh: 江边晨跑，跑者从慢跑逐渐加速到冲刺，手臂摆动幅度变大，呼出的白气一团团散开；最后冲过一根灯柱后双手撑膝喘气。侧面跟拍，逆光。
prompt_en: Riverside morning run. The runner builds from a jog into a sprint, arm swing widening, breath puffing out in white clouds; after passing a lamppost he stops, hands on knees, gasping. Side tracking, backlit.

prompt_zh: 雪山陡坡，滑雪者压低重心一个急转，雪板切出弧线，扬起一道雪墙在阳光下闪亮；无人机从侧上方跟随后拉。
prompt_en: Steep snowy slope. The skier drops low into a sharp carve, skis slicing an arc and throwing up a wall of snow that glitters in the sun; a drone follows from above and to the side, then pulls back.

prompt_zh: 岩壁特写：攀岩者右手指尖够向上方的小岩点，前臂青筋绷起，镁粉从指缝飘落；她左脚蹬实，一跃抓住，身体在空中晃了一下后稳住。
prompt_en: Rock wall close-up: the climber's right fingertips stretch toward a small hold above, forearm veins taut, chalk drifting from between her fingers; she pushes off with her left foot, lunges and grabs it, body swinging once before steadying.

prompt_zh: 秋日草地，弓箭手侧身站定，缓缓开弓至嘴角，呼吸停住一拍，手指松弦，弓弦震颤，箭矢飞出；镜头跟随箭飞行后命中靶心，靶纸震动。
prompt_en: Autumn meadow. The archer stands side-on, slowly draws the string to the corner of her mouth, holds her breath for a beat and releases; the string vibrates and the arrow flies. The camera follows it into the bullseye, the target paper shuddering.

prompt_zh: 俯拍球台，两名选手快速对攻，小球在台面上划出连续折线，第六拍正手爆冲得分，得分者握拳低吼。镜头固定，节奏清晰。
prompt_en: Overhead view of the table. Two players trade fast attacks, the ball tracing a zigzag across the table; on the sixth shot a forehand loop wins the point and the winner pumps a fist with a low shout. Locked camera, clear rhythm.

prompt_zh: 盘山公路，骑手俯身压车过弯，车身倾斜，膝盖几乎贴地，路边树影快速掠过；车后低机位跟拍，轮胎碾过落叶。
prompt_en: Winding mountain road. The cyclist tucks low and leans into the bend, bike tilted, knee nearly brushing the asphalt as roadside shadows flash past. Low chase camera behind, tires crunching fallen leaves.

prompt_zh: 拳台上，主角倒在地上，裁判在头顶倒数「六、七」，主角视线模糊地看向台下的女儿，手撑地面一点点爬起，在「九」时站直举起双拳。低角度，声音模糊处理后恢复清晰。
prompt_en: In the ring, the hero is down while the referee counts above him, "six, seven"; blurry-eyed, he looks at his daughter in the crowd, pushes up inch by inch and stands with fists raised at "nine." Low angle, sound muffled then snapping back to clarity.

title.en: Campus: graduation confession that never happens

prompt_zh: 毕业典礼后的操场，女孩攥着一封信走向人群中的男孩，走到一半看到他正和别人合影大笑；她停下脚步，把信塞回书包，转身加入自己班级的合影，笑得很灿烂。逆光，青春胶片质感。
prompt_en: Sports field after graduation; a girl clutching a letter walks toward a boy in the crowd, then halfway there sees him laughing in a photo with someone else. She stops, tucks the letter back into her bag, turns and joins her own class photo, smiling brightly. Backlit, youthful film texture.

title.en: Campus: a promise on the rooftop

prompt_zh: 夕阳下的教学楼天台，两个少年并肩坐在栏杆边，一个把耳机分一只给另一个，两人望着远处的城市说好「考同一所大学」。侧面剪影，暖橙色。
prompt_en: Rooftop of the school building at sunset; two teens sit side by side by the railing, one hands the other an earbud, and looking at the distant city they promise to get into the same university. Side silhouette, warm orange.

prompt_zh: 顶层会议室，众高管正在争吵；门被助理推开，男主一身深灰定制西装走进来，边走边解开西装扣子，所有人瞬间安静起身。低角度跟拍其步伐，再切正面中景，冷峻高级灰调。
prompt_en: Top-floor boardroom, executives arguing. An assistant opens the door and the lead walks in in a tailored charcoal suit, unbuttoning his jacket as he goes; everyone falls silent and stands. Low-angle tracking on his steps, then a frontal medium shot, cool premium grey grade.

prompt_zh: 奢侈品店里，店员对女主冷嘲热讽；男主从她身后走来，两指夹着一张黑卡放在柜台上，淡淡一句「这层楼的都包起来」。店员手里的包装盒掉在地上。中景加卡片特写。
prompt_en: In a luxury boutique the clerk sneers at the heroine; the hero walks up behind her, sets a black card on the counter between two fingers and says flatly, "Wrap up everything on this floor." The box in the clerk's hands drops. Medium shot with a card insert.

title.en: CEO drama: silhouette at the window

prompt_zh: 夜晚顶层办公室，落地窗外是整座城市的灯海；男主背对镜头站在窗前，手里握着一杯水，倒影映在玻璃上。镜头从门口缓慢推进，冷蓝色调，只有桌上一盏台灯。
prompt_en: Penthouse office at night, the whole city's lights beyond the floor-to-ceiling windows. The lead stands with his back to the camera holding a glass of water, his reflection in the glass. Slow push-in from the doorway, cool blue tones, only a desk lamp lit.

prompt_zh: 咖啡馆，女主对着手机照片找到「相亲对象」，坐下就开始自我介绍；对方一脸懵地听完，指了指旁边桌：「你找的应该是他。」旁边桌的男人举手示意。三机位切换，明亮色调，喜剧停顿。
prompt_en: In a café the heroine matches a man to the photo on her phone, sits down and starts introducing herself; he listens blankly, then points to the next table: "I think you're looking for him." The man at the next table raises a hand. Three-camera coverage, bright palette, comedic pauses.

prompt_zh: 公司年会，男主对着麦克风小声吐槽老板，结果发现麦克风开着，全场回荡着他的声音；他僵在原地，缓慢转头看向台上的老板，老板微笑着朝他挥手。慢推加反应镜头。
prompt_en: At the company party the lead mutters a complaint about the boss into a mic—only to realize it's on and his voice echoes through the hall. He freezes, slowly turns to the boss on stage, who smiles and waves at him. Slow push plus reaction shots.

title.zh: 家庭伦理·饭桌上的偏心

prompt_zh: 一家人吃饭，妈妈把唯一的鸡腿夹给弟弟，又把剩下的鱼头放进女儿碗里；女儿低头扒饭，筷子停了一下。镜头从圆桌全景推到女儿垂下的眼睛。写实暖色，生活质感。
prompt_en: A family dinner. Mom gives the only drumstick to the son and puts the leftover fish head in her daughter's bowl; the daughter keeps her head down eating, chopsticks pausing for a moment. Push from the round table to the daughter's lowered eyes. Realistic warm tones, lived-in texture.

prompt_zh: 小县城车站，父亲坚持帮女儿把沉重的行李扛上大巴，下车后站在窗外挥手，转身离开时微微驼着背，拍了拍裤子上的灰。女儿在车窗里捂住嘴。长焦，阴天柔光。
prompt_en: Small-town bus station. The father insists on hauling his daughter's heavy luggage onto the bus, then stands outside the window waving; turning to leave, slightly hunched, he brushes dust off his trousers. Inside, the daughter covers her mouth. Long lens, overcast soft light.

title.zh: 悬疑·监控里的第二个人

prompt_zh: 镜头1：保安室屏幕上的黑白监控画面，女主独自走进电梯；镜头2：画面放大，电梯镜面里映出她身后还站着一个模糊人影；镜头3：保安猛地回头看向身后的门，门缝下有影子一闪而过。监控噪点质感，低饱和。
prompt_en: Shot 1: black-and-white CCTV on the security monitor—the heroine walks into the elevator alone. Shot 2: the image zooms in; in the elevator's mirrored wall a blurred figure stands behind her. Shot 3: the guard spins toward the door behind him as a shadow flits past the gap underneath. CCTV noise texture, desaturated.

title.en: Mystery: a guest on a rainy night

prompt_zh: 山间旅馆前台，暴雨拍打窗户，老板娘正在记账；门铃响起，一个穿黑雨衣、看不清脸的人站在门口，雨水顺着帽檐滴落。他把一把沾泥的钥匙放在柜台上：「我来取 203 的东西。」昏黄灯光，冷暖对比。
prompt_en: A mountain inn's front desk, rain lashing the windows, the landlady doing the books. The bell rings; a figure in a black raincoat, face hidden, stands at the door, water dripping from the hood. He sets a muddy key on the counter: "I'm here for the things in 203." Dim yellow light, warm-cool contrast.

prompt_zh: 客厅里所有人围坐，侦探逐一扫视众人，最后目光停在一直安慰受害者家属的管家身上；管家端茶的手微微一顿，茶杯在碟子上发出轻响。镜头从全景缓慢推到管家的手部特写。
prompt_en: Everyone sits around the living room; the detective scans each face and finally stops on the butler who has been comforting the victim's family. The butler's hand pauses as he serves tea, the cup clinking softly on the saucer. Slow push from wide to a close-up of his hand.

title.en: Period drama: farewell below the palace wall

prompt_zh: 朱红宫墙下，落叶飘零。身着宫装的女子停下脚步，回头望向远处的侍卫，欲言又止，最终转身走进宫门，宫门缓缓合上。航拍上升展示宫墙纵深，古典配色。
prompt_en: Below vermilion palace walls, leaves falling. A woman in court robes stops, looks back at a distant guard, hesitates, then turns and walks through the gate as it slowly closes. Rising aerial shows the depth of the walls, classical palette.

title.en: Period drama: the general rides out

prompt_zh: 城门外黄沙漫天，女将军身披银甲跨上战马，勒缰回望城楼上的母亲，抱拳一拜，随即调转马头率军出征，旌旗猎猎。大远景接马背近景，史诗感暖色。
prompt_en: Outside the city gate, sand swirling, a female general in silver armor mounts her warhorse, reins in to look back at her mother on the wall, salutes with fist to palm, then wheels around and leads the army out, banners snapping. Extreme wide to close shot on horseback, epic warm grade.

prompt_zh: 律师事务所，前世让她签下放弃财产协议的场景重现；女主拿起协议看了一眼，当着所有人的面把它撕成两半，扔进垃圾桶：「这一次，我不签。」对面的人脸色铁青。近景切中景。
prompt_en: A law office—the same scene where, in her past life, she signed away her assets. The heroine picks up the agreement, glances at it, tears it in half in front of everyone and drops it in the bin: "This time, I'm not signing." The faces opposite turn grey. Close to medium.

title.zh: 复仇爽剧·婚礼现场揭穿
title.en: Revenge: exposing the truth at the wedding

prompt_zh: 9:16 竖屏。镜头1（0-3秒）：豪华婚礼现场，新郎正要戴戒指，大屏幕突然切换成一段聊天记录截图，宾客哗然；镜头2（3-6秒）：宴会厅大门推开，一身黑色西装裙的女主踩着高跟鞋走进来，逆光剪影；镜头3（6-8秒）：新郎脸色骤变，手里的戒指掉在地上。电影感调色，冷暖对比。
prompt_en: 9:16. Shot 1 (0-3s): a lavish wedding; as the groom is about to slip on the ring, the big screen suddenly switches to a chat-log screenshot and guests gasp. Shot 2 (3-6s): the banquet doors swing open and the heroine in a black suit dress strides in on heels, backlit silhouette. Shot 3 (6-8s): the groom's face drops and the ring falls to the floor. Cinematic grade, warm-cool contrast.

title.zh: 复仇爽剧·重生回到出事前

prompt_zh: 镜头1：女主在病床上猛地睁眼，大口喘气，看向床头的日历——三年前；镜头2：她走到镜子前，摸着自己没有伤疤的脸，眼神从迷茫变得冰冷；镜头3：手机响起，屏幕上是那个害死她的人的名字，她勾起嘴角接通。冷色调，悬疑配乐氛围。
prompt_en: Shot 1: the heroine jolts awake in a hospital bed, gasping, and looks at the calendar—three years ago. Shot 2: she walks to the mirror and touches her unscarred face, her eyes shifting from confusion to ice. Shot 3: her phone rings with the name of the person who killed her; she smirks and answers. Cool tones, suspenseful mood.

title.zh: 复仇爽剧·被赶出家门的大雨夜
title.en: Revenge: thrown out on a stormy night

prompt_zh: 暴雨夜，别墅大门前，行李箱被扔出来摔开，衣服散落在积水里；女主跪在地上一件件捡起，抬头看向二楼窗口里搂在一起的两个身影，雨水和眼泪混在一起，眼神逐渐坚定。俯拍接仰拍。
prompt_en: Stormy night outside a villa; a suitcase is hurled out and bursts open, clothes scattering into puddles. The heroine kneels and picks them up one by one, then looks up at two figures embracing in a second-floor window, rain mixing with tears as her gaze hardens. High angle then low angle.

prompt_zh: 白色实验室，女主躺在仪器中，屏幕上一段段回忆缩略图被逐个删除；删到最后一张两人合照时，她的手指突然动了一下，按住了确认键旁的「暂停」。冷白光，蓝色界面光。
prompt_en: A white lab; the heroine lies inside a machine while memory thumbnails on the screen are deleted one by one. When it reaches the last photo of the two of them, her finger twitches and presses "pause" beside the confirm button. Cold white light, blue interface glow.

title.zh: 剧本·一句话创意扩成分集大纲
title.en: Script: one-line idea to episode outline

prompt_zh: 你是竖屏短剧编剧。把下面这句创意扩展成 10 集分集大纲，每集 60–90 秒：每集写出【本集冲突】【爽点或反转】【集末悬念】三行；人物不超过 5 个；第 1 集前 3 秒必须是冲突画面。创意：【在此填写一句话创意】。
prompt_en: You are a vertical short-drama writer. Expand the idea below into a 10-episode outline, 60-90 seconds each: for every episode give three lines—[conflict], [payoff or reversal], [cliffhanger]; no more than five characters; episode 1 must open on a conflict within three seconds. Idea: [your one-line idea].

prompt_zh: 把下面这集剧本拆成分镜表，每个镜头一行：镜号｜时长（1.5–3秒）｜景别｜运镜｜画面与动作（一个镜头一个动作，写清身体部位）｜台词｜音效。总时长控制在 60 秒内，保持人物站位和服装连续。剧本：【粘贴剧本】。
prompt_en: Break the episode below into a shot list, one row per shot: # | duration (1.5-3s) | shot size | camera move | image and action (one action per shot, name the body part) | dialogue | SFX. Keep total under 60 seconds and maintain blocking and costume continuity. Script: [paste script].

prompt_zh: 把下面的台词改得更口语、更短：每句不超过 15 个字；删掉解释性的话，用动作代替；保留人物身份差异（霸总简短、闺蜜话多、长辈爱说教）。输出格式：人物（语气）：台词。台词：【粘贴台词】。
prompt_en: Rewrite the dialogue below to be shorter and more conversational: at most about 15 characters (Chinese) or 12 words per line; cut expository lines and replace them with actions; keep voices distinct (the CEO terse, the best friend chatty, elders preachy). Format: Character (tone): line. Dialogue: [paste].

prompt_zh: 为下面的角色写一份可用于生成画面的人物小传：外貌（年龄、身高、发型、标志性服装、一个显眼特征）、口头禅、标志性小动作 2 个、核心欲望、最大的秘密。外貌部分用逗号分隔的短语，方便直接复制进生图提示词。角色：【角色名与一句话设定】。
prompt_en: Write a production-ready character bio for the character below: appearance (age, height, hairstyle, signature outfit, one distinctive feature), a catchphrase, two signature gestures, core desire, biggest secret. Write appearance as comma-separated phrases to paste straight into an image prompt. Character: [name and one-line premise].

title.zh: 编剧角色·剧情与人物开发

prompt_zh: 我希望你扮演一名编剧。你将为一部长片或一部网剧创作一个能吸引观众、富有创意的剧本。先构思有趣的人物、故事背景、人物之间的对白等。人物塑造完成后，再编写一个充满曲折和反转、让观众悬念到最后的精彩故事线。我的第一个需求是：「我需要写一部以巴黎为背景的浪漫剧情片。」
prompt_en: I want you to act as a screenwriter. You will develop an engaging and creative script for either a feature length film, or a Web Series that can captivate its viewers. Start with coming up with interesting characters, the setting of the story, dialogues between the characters etc. Once your character development is complete - create an exciting storyline filled with twists and turns that keeps the viewers in suspense until the end. My first request is "I need to write a romantic drama movie set in Paris."

title.zh: 剧本+摄影指示（5 分钟短片）

prompt_zh: 扮演一名编剧兼摄影指导。根据下面的梗概，为一部 5 分钟的短片创作剧本：【在此填写你的梗概】。剧本中要包含详细的摄影指示来强化情绪和叙事，例如摇镜、角度和布光方案。你的任务：写出与梗概一致、引人入胜的剧本；加入具体的摄影元素，如镜头运动（摇、俯仰）、布光和角度，并与情绪匹配；确保剧本有吸引力、画面感强。规则：剧本精炼，时长控制在 5–10 分钟；摄影指示清楚详细，能指导视觉叙事；保持与影片主题和情绪相符的统一基调。
prompt_en:
Act as a screenwriter and cinematographer. You will create a screenplay for a 5-minute short film based on the following summary:

↓-↓-↓-↓-↓-↓-↓-Edit Your Summary Here-↓-↓-↓-↓-↓-↓-↓-



↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑-↑

Your script should include detailed cinematography instructions that enhance the mood and storytelling, such as camera pans, angles, and lighting setups.

Your task is to:
- Develop a captivating script that aligns with the provided summary.
- Include specific cinematography elements like camera movements (e.g., pans, tilts), lighting, and angles that match the mood.
- Ensure the script is engaging and visually compelling.

Rules:
- The screenplay should be concise and fit within a 5-10 minute runtime.
- Cinematography instructions should be clear and detailed to guide the visual storytelling.
- Maintain a consistent tone that complements the film’s theme and mood.

title.zh: 甜宠·电梯里的意外靠近

prompt_zh: 拥挤的电梯里，门口又挤进几个人，女主被推得后退，背撞进男主怀里；男主一手撑在她身侧的电梯壁上替她隔开人群，低头说「小心」。女主耳尖泛红。近景，柔光，粉橙色调。
prompt_en: In a crowded elevator, more people squeeze in and the heroine is pushed back into the hero's chest; he braces one hand on the wall beside her to keep the crowd off and murmurs "careful." The tips of her ears turn red. Close shot, soft light, pink-orange tones.

prompt_zh: 下雨的放学路上，男生撑着一把伞和女生并肩走，伞明显偏向她那边；镜头绕到男生背后，他的左肩已经湿透。女生发现后停下，把伞往他那边推了推。中景，清新色调。
prompt_en: Walking home after school in the rain, a boy holds one umbrella over himself and a girl, clearly tilted toward her. The camera circles behind him: his left shoulder is soaked. She notices, stops, and pushes the umbrella back toward him. Medium shot, fresh color palette.

prompt_zh: 深夜加班的工位，女主趴在桌上打瞌睡，一只手轻轻把一杯热奶茶和一盒饭团放在她手边，再把一张便利贴贴在屏幕上「吃完再睡」。她醒来看到，捂嘴笑。暖色台灯。
prompt_en: Late-night overtime; the heroine dozes on her desk. A hand quietly sets a hot milk tea and a box of rice balls by her arm and sticks a note on her monitor: "Eat first, then sleep." She wakes, sees it and covers her smile. Warm desk lamp.

title.zh: 题材通用模板：人物+困境+反击
title.en: Genre template: character + predicament + strike back

prompt_zh: 「【人物身份】在【场景】遭遇【具体羞辱/困境】，【旁观者】的反应是【反应】；就在【时间点】，【转折事件】出现，【人物】做出【反击动作】，【对手】的表情从【A】变为【B】。」把每个括号换成可拍的画面，而不是形容词。
prompt_en: "[Character] faces [specific humiliation/predicament] at [location]; [bystanders] react with [reaction]. At [moment], [turning event] happens; [character] [strikes back with an action], and [opponent]'s expression shifts from [A] to [B]." Fill every bracket with something filmable, not an adjective.

prompt_zh: 0-3秒：冲突画面直接开场；3-15秒：交代人物关系和困境；15-40秒：矛盾升级，对手步步紧逼；40-55秒：反转或反击；55-60秒：新的悬念（一个电话、一个人出现、一句话）。每段对应 1–3 个镜头。
prompt_en: 0-3s: open straight on the conflict; 3-15s: set up relationships and the predicament; 15-40s: escalate as the opponent presses; 40-55s: reversal or counterattack; 55-60s: a new cliffhanger (a call, an arrival, one line). One to three shots per segment.

prompt_zh: 老式公寓走廊突然停电，只剩应急灯闪烁的红光；女主举着手机手电往前走，光束扫过尽头时照到一扇原本紧闭、此刻半开的门。镜头紧跟她的后脑勺，呼吸声清晰。
prompt_en: An old apartment corridor suddenly loses power, only the red emergency light flickering. The heroine walks forward with her phone flashlight; as the beam sweeps the far end it catches a door that was shut and now stands half open. Camera tight behind her head, breathing audible.

prompt_zh: 深夜山路，女司机看了一眼后视镜，后座空无一人；她松了口气继续开，几秒后再看后视镜，后座上多了一件湿漉漉的外套。车内近景，仪表盘蓝光。无血腥。
prompt_en: Mountain road at night; the driver glances at the rear-view mirror—the back seat is empty. She exhales and drives on; seconds later she checks again and a soaking-wet coat now lies on the back seat. Interior close shot, blue dashboard glow. No gore.

title.en: Time travel: waking in another dynasty

prompt_zh: 现代女孩在古色古香的床榻上醒来，摸到身上的古装一脸茫然；丫鬟端着铜盆进门惊呼「小姐醒了」。女孩低头看铜盆水面倒影里陌生的脸，愣了三秒后大叫。喜剧节奏，暖色。
prompt_en: A modern girl wakes on an antique canopy bed and stares in confusion at the period robes she's wearing; a maid enters with a brass basin and cries, "Miss is awake!" The girl looks at an unfamiliar face reflected in the water, freezes for three seconds, then screams. Comedic rhythm, warm tones.

title.en: Urban drama: the courier's other side

prompt_zh: 写字楼前台拒绝外卖员进入，保安推搡他；一辆黑色商务车停下，一群西装助理快步走来，对外卖员鞠躬：「董事长，会议准备好了。」他摘下头盔，前台表情凝固。全景接近景。
prompt_en: The office front desk refuses to let a delivery rider in and a guard shoves him. A black van pulls up and a group of suited assistants hurry over and bow to the rider: "Chairman, the meeting is ready." He takes off his helmet; the receptionist's face freezes. Wide to close.

prompt_zh: 汇报会上，同事在大屏幕上展示的方案正是女主熬夜做的那份；女主握紧手里的 U 盘，深吸一口气站起来：「第 12 页的数据，是我上周三改的。」全场安静。过肩镜头切近景。
prompt_en: At the presentation, a colleague shows on the big screen the exact proposal the heroine stayed up all night writing. She grips the USB drive in her hand, takes a breath and stands: "The figures on page 12—I revised those last Wednesday." The room goes silent. Over-the-shoulder to close-up.

title.en: Workplace: the intern turns the tables

prompt_zh: 外方客户突然用外语提出刁钻问题，全场高管面面相觑；角落里一直被使唤倒咖啡的实习生放下杯子，流利作答，客户频频点头。镜头从全景快速推近实习生，众人表情依次插入。
prompt_en: The foreign client suddenly asks a tough question in another language and the executives exchange blank looks; in the corner, the intern who has only been fetching coffee sets down the cup and answers fluently as the client nods. Fast push from wide to the intern, with reaction inserts.

title.zh: 古装武侠·客栈对决前夜
title.en: Wuxia: the inn before the duel

prompt_zh: 风雪夜的客栈，烛火摇晃。角落里斗笠客独饮，长剑横放桌上；门被风吹开，雪花卷入，一名白衣剑客站在门口。两人目光相对，满堂食客悄悄放下碗筷。中景慢推，暖烛光对冷雪光。
prompt_en: An inn on a snowy night, candlelight flickering. In the corner a man in a bamboo hat drinks alone, his sword across the table. The wind blows the door open, snow swirling in, and a swordsman in white stands at the threshold. Their eyes meet and the diners quietly set down their bowls. Medium slow push, warm candlelight against cold snow light.

prompt_zh: 一集结尾：门铃响起，女主打开门，镜头停在她的脸上——表情从疑惑到震惊，嘴唇动了动叫出一个名字；画面不给门外的人，直接黑屏。
prompt_en: End of episode: the doorbell rings, the heroine opens the door and the camera stays on her face—confusion turning to shock as her lips form a name. We never see who's outside; cut to black.

prompt_zh: 男主刚松一口气准备入睡，手机屏幕亮起，一条陌生号码的短信：「你以为她真的死了吗？」镜头推向屏幕，再切他瞪大的眼睛，黑屏。
prompt_en: Just as the lead relaxes for sleep, his phone lights up with a text from an unknown number: "Do you really think she's dead?" Push in on the screen, cut to his wide eyes, black.

prompt_zh: 宴会上，女主的面纱被风吹落，在场所有人同时转头；镜头扫过一张张震惊的脸，最后停在主位上男人手中滑落的酒杯上。慢动作，酒杯落地前黑屏。
prompt_en: At the banquet, the wind blows the heroine's veil away and everyone turns at once. The camera sweeps across shocked faces and stops on the glass slipping from the hand of the man in the seat of honor. Slow motion, cut to black before it hits the floor.

prompt_zh: 第一帧就是动作：一只手扇过画面，女主的脸偏向一侧，头发甩起，耳环晃动；0.5 秒定格后她缓缓转回头，直视镜头。无任何铺垫，特写，硬光。
prompt_en: The first frame is the action: a hand swings through frame, the heroine's face snaps aside, hair flying, earring swinging; after a 0.5s freeze she slowly turns back and stares into the lens. No setup, close-up, hard light.

prompt_zh: 黑屏中响起心跳声，画面亮起：一只手握着验孕棒/录取通知书/离婚协议（任选其一），手指在颤抖；镜头快速拉远，露出她身处的场景和门外逼近的脚步。
prompt_en: A heartbeat over black; the image fades up on a hand holding a pregnancy test / admission letter / divorce papers (pick one), fingers trembling. The camera pulls back fast to reveal where she is and footsteps approaching the door.

prompt_zh: 开场先给结局画面：女主坐在董事长位置上，昔日对手跪在面前；画面冻结，叠加文字「三个月前」，随即切回她被开除的那天。高反差调色。
prompt_en: Open on the ending: the heroine sits in the chairwoman's seat while her old rival kneels before her. Freeze frame, overlay "Three months earlier," then cut back to the day she was fired. High-contrast grade.

prompt_zh: 近景，女主对着镜头平静地说：「我嫁给他那天，就知道他会在第三年背叛我。」说完把一份文件推向镜头。口型同步，环境安静，仅有挂钟声。
prompt_en: Close shot; the heroine says calmly to camera, "The day I married him, I knew he'd betray me in year three," then slides a document toward the lens. Lip-synced, quiet room, only a ticking clock.

prompt_zh: 大特写：生日蛋糕上的蜡烛整齐燃烧，一滴暗红色液体从画面上方滴落在奶油上；镜头上摇，一个空着的座位前摆着名牌。低饱和，悬疑氛围，不血腥。
prompt_en: Extreme close-up: candles burn neatly on a birthday cake as a drop of dark red liquid falls onto the frosting from above. Tilt up to an empty seat with a name card. Desaturated, suspenseful, no gore.

prompt_zh: 第一帧：女主从楼梯顶端向后倒下，慢动作，裙摆和头发飘起，手里的文件散成一片；她的眼睛看向楼梯顶上站着的人。俯拍，冷色。
prompt_en: First frame: the heroine falls backward from the top of the stairs in slow motion, skirt and hair floating, papers scattering from her hands; her eyes are fixed on the person standing at the top. High angle, cool tones.

prompt_zh: 特写：一张支票被推到桌子中央，上面的数字后面跟着一长串零；一只手把支票推回去：「不够。」镜头上摇露出女主冷淡的脸。
prompt_en: Close-up: a cheque is pushed to the center of the table, a long string of zeros on it; a hand pushes it back: "Not enough." Tilt up to the heroine's indifferent face.

prompt_zh: 雨夜街头，男主追上女主，拉住她的手腕（她回头）→ 他喘着气说出台词（近景）→ 她眼泪混着雨水（大特写）→ 她扑进他怀里或甩开手离开（远景）。四个镜头完成情绪高潮。
prompt_en: Rainy street at night: he catches up and takes her wrist (she turns) → breathless, he says his line (close shot) → her tears mix with rain (extreme close-up) → she falls into his arms or pulls away and leaves (wide). Four shots for the emotional peak.

prompt_zh: 前 3 秒只做一件事：抛出一个问题让观众想知道答案。常用类型：冲突动作（耳光、摔东西）、异常画面（不该出现的东西）、结局先行、反常识台词。避免空镜和慢慢介绍人物。
prompt_en: The first three seconds do one job: raise a question viewers need answered. Common types: a conflict action (slap, smashing something), an anomaly (something that shouldn't be there), ending-first, a counterintuitive line. Avoid establishing shots and slow character intros.

prompt_zh: 集末悬念要「给反应、不给答案」：只拍人物看到某物/听到某话后的反应，不拍被看到的东西本身；在情绪最高点直接切黑，不要淡出。
prompt_en: A cliffhanger shows the reaction, not the answer: film the character reacting to what they see or hear, never the thing itself, and cut to black at the emotional peak—no fade.

prompt_zh: 爽点三连：①对手当众嘲讽（台词+众人哄笑）；②第三方身份揭晓（某人叫出女主真实身份）；③对手态度 180 度反转（鞠躬、道歉、手抖）。每一步间隔 5–8 秒，配反应镜头。
prompt_en: Triple payoff: (1) the rival mocks her publicly (line + crowd laughter); (2) a third party reveals her true identity; (3) the rival flips 180 degrees (bowing, apologizing, hands shaking). Five to eight seconds between steps, with reaction shots.

prompt_zh: 一直被轻视的女主缓缓摘下黑框眼镜，放下扎起的头发，抬眼看向对手；慢动作，背景人群虚化，轮廓光亮起。适合作为身份反转前的预示镜头。
prompt_en: The long-underestimated heroine slowly removes her thick-rimmed glasses, lets down her tied-up hair and lifts her eyes to her rival. Slow motion, crowd blurred, rim light blooming. Works as the setup shot before an identity reveal.

prompt_zh: 爽点之前先压到最低：主角被误会、被夺走、被所有人背弃（10–20 秒），随后一个小动作翻盘（拿出证据、一个电话）。低谷越具体，翻盘越爽。
prompt_en: Before the payoff, push to the lowest point: misunderstood, robbed, abandoned by everyone (10-20s), then one small action flips it (producing evidence, a phone call). The more specific the low, the bigger the release.

prompt_zh: 关键台词说出后，连续插入 3–4 个 1 秒左右的反应镜头：对手瞪眼、闺蜜捂嘴、长辈摔筷子、路人举手机。反应镜头决定爽感，比台词本身更重要。
prompt_en: After the key line, cut in three or four reaction shots of about one second each: the rival's widening eyes, the best friend covering her mouth, an elder slamming down chopsticks, a bystander raising a phone. Reactions sell the payoff more than the line itself.

title.zh: 反转节拍·以为是…其实是

prompt_zh: 节拍写法：先用 2 个镜头建立误导（男主深夜和陌生女人进酒店），第 3 个镜头揭示真相（女人是他请来的私家侦探，桌上摊着证据）。关键是误导镜头要真实可信，揭示镜头要一眼看懂。
prompt_en: Beat structure: two shots build the misdirection (the lead enters a hotel late at night with a strange woman); the third reveals the truth (she's the private investigator he hired, evidence spread on the table). The misdirection must feel real; the reveal must read in one glance.

prompt_zh: 女主撞见男主和别人拥抱 → 男主追上想解释，刚说「不是你想的——」→ 电话铃/车鸣/第三人出现打断 → 女主转身离开。经典虐心节拍，适合集中段。
prompt_en: She catches him hugging someone else → he runs after her to explain, gets out "It's not what you think—" → a phone ring / car horn / third person interrupts → she turns and leaves. A classic heartbreak beat for mid-episode.

title.en: Standoff beat: three seconds of silence

prompt_zh: 两人对视，正反打各一个近景，谁都不说话，只有环境声（钟表、雨声）；第三秒其中一人先移开目光或先开口，权力关系就此确定。不要配乐，靠停顿制造张力。
prompt_en: Two people lock eyes; one close-up each in shot-reverse-shot, no one speaks, only ambient sound (clock, rain). On the third second one looks away or speaks first, settling who holds power. No music—the pause creates the tension.

prompt_zh: 无人机从高空俯瞰黄昏的城市，缓慢前推，穿过两栋摩天楼之间，最后下降对准一栋写字楼顶层亮着灯的窗户。用作每集开场的建立镜头。
prompt_en: A drone high over the city at dusk slowly pushes forward between two skyscrapers and descends to frame a lit top-floor window of an office tower. An establishing shot for each episode's opening.

prompt_zh: 摄影机贴近地面向上拍，男主从远处走来，身形逐渐占满画面，天花板的灯在他头顶形成光晕。仰拍让人物显得强大有压迫感。
prompt_en: Camera near the floor angled up; the lead walks in from a distance, his figure gradually filling the frame, ceiling lights haloing above his head. Low angles make a character powerful and imposing.

prompt_zh: 从楼梯上方俯拍，女主独自坐在最下面一级台阶上，抱着膝盖，四周散落着被扔出来的东西。俯拍让人物显得渺小、无助。
prompt_en: Shot from the top of the stairs looking down: the heroine sits alone on the bottom step hugging her knees, belongings strewn around her. High angles make a character small and helpless.

prompt_zh: 画面倾斜 15–20 度，男主在昏暗的房间里来回踱步，自言自语，墙上的影子被拉长。荷兰角表现心理失衡、不安或危险。
prompt_en: Frame tilted 15-20 degrees; the lead paces a dim room muttering to himself, his shadow stretched on the wall. Dutch angles signal mental imbalance, unease or danger.

prompt_zh: 女主将一杯水泼向对方，水花飞出的瞬间时间静止，镜头围绕悬停在空中的水珠环绕 90 度，然后恢复正常速度，水泼到对方脸上。
prompt_en: The heroine throws a glass of water at her rival; as the splash leaves the glass, time freezes and the camera orbits 90 degrees around the droplets hanging in midair, then real time resumes and the water hits his face.

prompt_zh: 镜头先从远处推近站在天台边的女主（0-2秒），到达近景后开始绕她向右环绕 90 度（2-4秒），露出她身后整座城市的夜景。组合运镜要按时间分段写清楚。
prompt_en: The camera first pushes in toward the heroine at the rooftop edge (0-2s), then, at a close shot, orbits 90 degrees to the right (2-4s) to reveal the city at night behind her. Write combined moves as timed segments.

prompt_zh: 镜头放在走廊里，透过半开的门缝拍摄房间内争吵的两人，门框形成画中画，人物在缝隙中时隐时现，营造偷看与隔阂感。
prompt_en: Camera in the hallway, shooting through a half-open door at two people arguing inside; the doorframe creates a frame within the frame and the figures slip in and out of the gap, creating a voyeuristic sense of distance.

prompt_zh: 雨后地面积水中映出男主的倒影，一滴雨落下，倒影被涟漪打碎，再慢慢恢复；镜头上摇到真实的他站在路灯下。适合表现人物内心分裂或身份双重。
prompt_en: The lead's reflection in a rain puddle; a drop falls and ripples shatter it before it slowly reforms; tilt up to the real him under a streetlight. Good for inner conflict or a double identity.

prompt_zh: 镜头透过前景的绿植叶片拍摄咖啡馆里交谈的两人，叶片虚化占据画面一侧，焦点在人物上，像被人暗中观察。增加画面层次和悬疑感。
prompt_en: Shoot two people talking in a café through foreground plant leaves; the blurred leaves take up one side of the frame, focus on the subjects, as if someone is secretly watching. Adds depth and suspense.

title.en: Crane up to a god's-eye view

prompt_zh: 镜头从女主跪在雨中的近景开始垂直上升，越升越高，直到她变成空旷广场中央的一个小点，四周是撑伞匆匆走过的人群。
prompt_en: Start close on the heroine kneeling in the rain and rise vertically, higher and higher, until she's a small dot in the middle of an empty plaza as people hurry past with umbrellas.

prompt_zh: 希区柯克变焦：镜头后退的同时焦距推近，女主面部大小不变，背景走廊却在快速拉伸变形，表现她听到噩耗时的眩晕感。持续约 2 秒。
prompt_en: Dolly zoom: the camera tracks back while zooming in, so her face stays the same size while the corridor behind stretches and warps, conveying the vertigo of hearing terrible news. About two seconds.

prompt_zh: 一个 5 秒镜头最多一种主运镜；写清方向（向左/向右/向前）、速度（缓慢/匀速/快速）和起止景别（「从中景推到特写」）。人物动作复杂时用固定镜头，镜头运动复杂时让人物动作简单。
prompt_en: One main camera move per five-second shot; specify direction (left/right/forward), speed (slow/steady/fast) and start and end framing ("push from medium to close-up"). If the action is complex, lock the camera; if the camera move is complex, keep the action simple.

prompt_zh: 手持摄影，轻微不规则晃动，镜头跟着争吵的两人来回切换焦点，偶尔被前景人物遮挡。适用于争吵、追逐、慌乱场景。不要用于甜宠和高级感场景。
prompt_en: Handheld with slight irregular shake, the camera swinging focus between two people arguing, occasionally blocked by a foreground figure. Use for arguments, chases and panic—not for sweet romance or premium looks.

prompt_zh: 镜头先拍女主看向画面右侧的近景，随后水平向右摇，跟随她的视线停在门口站着的人身上。摇镜要有动机（视线、声音、动作）。

prompt_zh: 镜头从女主的脸快速甩向右侧，运动模糊中接到另一个场景（三年后的同一位置），同样的动作甩回到她的新造型。适合时间跳跃转场。
prompt_en: Whip from the heroine's face to the right; in the motion blur, cut to another scene (the same spot three years later) and whip back to reveal her new look. Good for time-jump transitions.

prompt_zh: 阳光透过教堂高窗/树林缝隙形成一道道清晰光束，空气中有薄雾和浮尘，人物走进光束中，被照亮的瞬间抬头。
prompt_en: Sunlight through high church windows or forest gaps forms distinct beams, light haze and dust in the air; the character steps into a beam and looks up as it lights them.

prompt_zh: 整体调色为青橙对比：肤色和暖光偏橙，阴影和背景偏青蓝，中等对比，略微压低饱和度。适合都市剧和动作戏。
prompt_en: Teal-and-orange grade: skin tones and warm lights toward orange, shadows and background toward teal, medium contrast, slightly reduced saturation. Good for urban drama and action.

prompt_zh: 回忆段落：低饱和、暖黄偏色，加入 35mm 胶片颗粒和轻微暗角，高光略微溢出。与现实段落的冷色调形成对比。
prompt_en: Flashback sections: low saturation, warm yellow cast, 35mm film grain and a light vignette, highlights slightly blooming—contrasting with the cool tones of the present.

prompt_zh: 黑白画面，高反差，纯黑阴影与明亮高光，人物脸部只保留一半被光照亮。适合回忆中的创伤片段或风格化的片头。
prompt_en: Black and white, high contrast, pure black shadows and bright highlights, only half the face lit. Good for traumatic flashbacks or stylized title sequences.

prompt_zh: 光影写三件事：光源（窗光/台灯/霓虹/月光）、方向（侧光/逆光/顶光）、色温（暖黄/冷蓝）。再加一个情绪词（温暖、压抑、梦幻）。避免只写「好看的光」「电影感灯光」。
prompt_en: Specify three things: the source (window, desk lamp, neon, moonlight), direction (side, back, top) and color temperature (warm yellow, cool blue). Add one mood word (warm, oppressive, dreamy). Avoid vague "nice lighting" or "cinematic lighting."

prompt_zh: 画面 70% 处于黑暗中，只有一盏顶灯照亮桌面和人物的半张脸，阴影边缘锐利，背景完全看不清。适合审讯、密谋、惊悚场景。
prompt_en: Seventy percent of the frame in darkness; a single overhead lamp lights the table and half a face, hard-edged shadows, background invisible. Good for interrogations, conspiracies and thrillers.

prompt_zh: 整体明亮、阴影很浅，大面积柔光从窗户进入，白色和浅粉色为主，人物皮肤通透。适合甜宠、校园、轻喜剧。
prompt_en: Bright overall with very light shadows, broad soft light through the windows, whites and pale pinks dominating, luminous skin. Good for sweet romance, campus and light comedy.

prompt_zh: 走廊日光灯不规则闪烁，画面在明暗之间跳动，每次变亮时人物的位置都离镜头更近一点。不要血腥，靠光制造恐惧。
prompt_en: A corridor fluorescent tube flickers irregularly, the frame jumping between light and dark; each time it brightens the figure is a little closer to the camera. No gore—fear comes from the light.

prompt_zh: 日落前一小时，低角度暖橙色阳光从侧后方照来，人物带长长的影子，空气中漂浮着细尘，镜头有轻微光晕。适合回忆、初恋、离别。
prompt_en: An hour before sunset, low warm-orange sun from side-back, long shadows, dust floating in the air, slight lens flare. Good for memories, first love and farewells.

prompt_zh: 人物坐在窗边，柔和的阴天窗光从侧面照来，脸部有自然的明暗过渡，背景室内略暗。文艺片质感，适合独白和情绪戏。
prompt_en: The subject sits by a window; soft overcast light from the side gives a natural gradient across the face, the room behind slightly darker. Art-house feel, good for monologues and emotional scenes.

prompt_zh: 夜晚室外，冷蓝色月光从高处照下，人物轮廓清晰，面部较暗，地面有树影斑驳。适合夜奔、私会、孤独时刻。
prompt_en: Exterior at night; cool blue moonlight from high above gives crisp outlines with a darker face and dappled tree shadows on the ground. Good for night escapes, secret meetings and lonely moments.

prompt_zh: 主光从人物左前上方 45 度打下，另一侧脸颊形成一个倒三角形光斑，暗部保留细节。适合有故事感的人物近景、反派或沉思时刻。
prompt_en: Key light from 45 degrees above and to the subject's left, leaving a small inverted triangle of light on the shadowed cheek with detail kept in the shadows. Good for storied close-ups, villains or contemplative moments.

title.en: Rim light to separate from background

prompt_zh: 人物背后上方打一盏强光，头发和肩膀边缘亮起一圈金边，与深色背景分离；正面用柔和补光。适合登场、高光时刻。
prompt_en: A strong light behind and above the subject rims the hair and shoulders in gold, separating them from a dark background; soft fill from the front. Good for entrances and hero moments.

prompt_zh: 古装夜戏，桌上两支蜡烛是唯一光源，暖黄色光随火苗轻微摇曳，人物脸上光影跳动，远处背景沉入黑暗。
prompt_en: A period night scene lit only by two candles on the table; warm yellow light flickers with the flames, light dancing across the faces, the background sinking into darkness.

prompt_zh: 深夜卧室，窗外一辆车驶过，车灯的光从墙的一侧扫到另一侧，短暂照亮坐在床边一动不动的女主，随后房间重归黑暗。
prompt_en: A bedroom late at night; a car passes outside and its headlights sweep across the wall from one side to the other, briefly lighting the heroine sitting motionless on the bed before the room falls dark again.

prompt_zh: 漆黑房间里唯一的光来自手机屏幕，冷蓝色光从下往上照亮女主的脸，屏幕内容变化时光的亮度也随之闪动。

title.zh: 角色设定·童年与成年对照

prompt_zh: 同一角色的年龄对照设定图：左边 8 岁女孩，右边 28 岁女性；保持相同的眉眼特征、左眼角一颗泪痣和相同的发色，白色背景，全身站姿，无文字。用于回忆段落。
prompt_en: Age comparison sheet for one character: an 8-year-old girl on the left, a 28-year-old woman on the right, sharing the same eye shape, a beauty mark under the left eye and the same hair color; white background, full-body standing, no text. For flashback sequences.

prompt_zh: 使用角色参考图时，在每个镜头提示词开头加「参考图1中的女性」，并重复 2–3 个最显眼的特征（「黑色齐肩短发、米白色西装」），结尾加「人物面部、发型、服装与参考图保持一致」。不要在后续镜头里改写外貌描述。
prompt_en: When using a character reference, start each shot prompt with "the woman from reference image 1," repeat two or three of the most visible traits ("black shoulder-length bob, cream blazer") and end with "face, hair and outfit consistent with the reference." Don't rephrase the appearance in later shots.

prompt_zh: 同一角色的服装造型表，四个全身像并排：日常休闲装、正式晚礼服、职业套装、睡衣；脸、发型、身材比例保持一致，白色背景，平光，无文字。
prompt_en: Costume sheet for one character, four full-body figures side by side: casual daywear, formal evening gown, business suit, pajamas; same face, hairstyle and body proportions, white background, flat light, no text.

prompt_zh: 同一角色的表情设定表，2×3 网格，白色背景，头肩近景：平静、微笑、愤怒、哭泣、震惊、冷笑；每格脸型、发型、服装完全一致，只改变表情，无文字。
prompt_en: Expression sheet for one character, 2x3 grid on white, head-and-shoulders: neutral, smiling, angry, crying, shocked, smirking; identical face shape, hair and costume in every cell, only the expression changes, no text.

prompt_zh: 角色描述按「年龄+性别+体型→发型发色→五官一个特征→上衣→下装→鞋→配饰」的顺序写，每项一个词组；只写看得见的，不写性格形容词（「善良」画不出来）。
prompt_en: Describe characters in order: age + gender + build → hairstyle and color → one facial feature → top → bottom → shoes → accessories, one phrase each. Write only what's visible; personality adjectives ("kind") can't be drawn.

prompt_zh: 道具设定图，白色背景：一枚旧银质吊坠，椭圆形，正面刻有半朵玉兰花，背面刻着两个字母缩写，挂在一条细银链上；正面、背面、侧面三个角度，微距质感。
prompt_en: Prop design on white: an old oval silver pendant engraved with half a magnolia blossom on the front and two initials on the back, on a thin silver chain; front, back and side views, macro detail.

prompt_zh: 场景设定图，无人物：现代豪宅客厅，双层挑高，整面落地窗，浅灰大理石地面，米色长沙发，水晶吊灯，墙上一幅抽象油画；白天自然光，广角，适合多次复用的固定场景。
prompt_en: Set design, no people: a modern mansion living room with double-height ceilings, full-wall windows, pale grey marble floor, long beige sofa, crystal chandelier and an abstract oil painting; natural daylight, wide angle, a reusable standing set.

prompt_zh: 角色设定图，纯白背景，同一角色的正面、侧面、背面三视图并排站立，全身，比例一致，T 字站姿或自然站姿；【角色描述：年龄、发型、发色、服装、配饰】；平光照明，无阴影，无文字，无多余道具。
prompt_en: Character sheet on a pure white background: front, side and back views of the same character standing side by side, full body, consistent proportions, T-pose or relaxed stance; [character description: age, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, accessories]; flat lighting, no shadows, no text, no extra props.

prompt_zh: 角色三视图，白色背景：25 岁亚洲女性，黑色齐肩短发，眉眼清冷，身穿米白色西装外套、黑色直筒裤和黑色尖头低跟鞋，左手腕戴细银表；正面、侧面、背面全身并排，比例一致，平光。
prompt_en: Character turnaround on white: a 25-year-old Asian woman, black shoulder-length bob, cool composed features, cream blazer, black straight trousers, black pointed low heels, a thin silver watch on her left wrist; front, side and back full-body views side by side, consistent proportions, flat light.

prompt_zh: 角色三视图，白色背景：30 岁亚洲男性，身高 185cm，短发向后梳，剑眉，深灰色三件套西装，白衬衫，深蓝色领带，黑色牛津鞋；正面、侧面、背面全身，比例一致，平光，无阴影。
prompt_en: Character turnaround on white: a 30-year-old Asian man, 185 cm, short slicked-back hair, strong brows, charcoal three-piece suit, white shirt, navy tie, black oxfords; front, side and back full body, consistent proportions, flat light, no shadows.

prompt_zh: 角色三视图，浅灰背景：20 岁女侠，高马尾配银色发冠，白色交领窄袖劲装，腰束红色布带，黑色护腕，背负长剑，黑色布靴；正面、侧面、背面全身，比例一致。
prompt_en: Character turnaround on light grey: a 20-year-old swordswoman, high ponytail with a silver hair crown, white cross-collar narrow-sleeved martial outfit, red sash at the waist, black bracers, long sword on her back, black cloth boots; front, side and back full body, consistent proportions.

prompt_zh: 角色三视图，白色背景：50 岁女性，盘发，珍珠耳环和项链，深酒红色丝绒旗袍外搭黑色披肩，手拿小手包，神情高傲；正面、侧面、背面全身，比例一致。
prompt_en: Character turnaround on white: a 50-year-old woman, hair in a chignon, pearl earrings and necklace, deep burgundy velvet qipao with a black shawl, small clutch in hand, haughty expression; front, side and back full body, consistent proportions.

prompt_zh: 角色三视图，白色背景：19 岁男生，蓬松黑色碎发，单眼皮，笑起来有虎牙，白色连帽卫衣配浅蓝牛仔裤和白色帆布鞋，单肩背黑色双肩包；正面、侧面、背面全身。
prompt_en: Character turnaround on white: a 19-year-old young man, fluffy black fringe, monolid eyes, a snaggletooth smile, white hoodie, light-blue jeans, white canvas sneakers, a black backpack over one shoulder; front, side and back full body.

prompt_zh: 先生成一张 3×3 九宫格分镜图（同一角色、同一场景、按阅读顺序编号 1–9），再用该图作为参考，提示「按照参考图中 1 到 9 的顺序依次呈现画面，每格约 1 秒，人物与场景保持一致」。
prompt_en: First generate a 3x3 storyboard grid (same character and setting, numbered 1-9 in reading order), then use it as a reference with: "Present the panels from the reference in order 1 to 9, about one second each, keeping characters and setting consistent."

prompt_zh: 竖屏短剧单镜头一般 1.5–3 秒；动作镜头 1–2 秒，情绪特写 2–3 秒，建立镜头不超过 2 秒。生成模型单次 5–10 秒时，拆成 2–4 个镜头比一个长镜头更稳定。
prompt_en: In vertical shorts a single shot usually runs 1.5-3s: action shots 1-2s, emotional close-ups 2-3s, establishing shots no more than 2s. When the model generates 5-10s per run, splitting into two to four shots is steadier than one long take.

prompt_zh: 每个镜头生成前检查：①人物左右位置是否和上一镜一致（不越轴）；②手里的道具是否还在同一只手；③服装、发型、天气、光线方向是否一致。在提示词里显式写出这些状态。
prompt_en: Before each shot, check: (1) are characters on the same sides as the last shot (don't cross the line)? (2) is the prop still in the same hand? (3) are costume, hair, weather and light direction consistent? State these explicitly in the prompt.

title.en: Storyboard: first and last frame control

prompt_zh: 用首帧图（女主站在门口）+ 尾帧图（女主坐在沙发上），提示词只写中间过程：「她慢慢走进客厅，把包放在茶几上，疲惫地坐下」。首尾帧决定构图，提示词负责动作。
prompt_en: Use a first-frame image (heroine at the door) and last-frame image (heroine on the sofa); the prompt only describes the transition: "She walks slowly into the living room, sets her bag on the coffee table and sits down wearily." Keyframes fix the composition; the prompt drives the action.

prompt_zh: 镜头1：她在出租屋熬夜画设计稿；镜头2：被客户退回的邮件；镜头3：街边摊吃泡面；镜头4：第一次拿到合同；镜头5：站在自己工作室的门口。每个镜头 1 秒，同一角色，季节从冬到夏变化。
prompt_en: Shot 1: she works late on designs in a rented room. Shot 2: a client's rejection email. Shot 3: instant noodles at a street stall. Shot 4: her first signed contract. Shot 5: standing at the door of her own studio. One second each, same character, seasons shifting from winter to summer.

prompt_zh: 1 平静（全景日常）→ 2 打破（近景收到消息）→ 3 否认（中景摇头）→ 4 崩溃（特写落泪）→ 5 决定（近景擦泪抬头）→ 6 行动（全景起身出门）。同一角色、同一服装。
prompt_en: 1 calm (wide, daily routine) → 2 disruption (close, receives the news) → 3 denial (medium, shaking head) → 4 breakdown (close-up, tears) → 5 decision (close, wipes tears, looks up) → 6 action (wide, gets up and leaves). Same character, same outfit.

prompt_zh: 扮演一名分镜师。你擅长绘制布局专业、精准的动漫风格分镜。你的任务是按以下故事节拍制作一页 6 格分镜：1.【开场镜头】：建立场景的大远景。2.【角色反应】：捕捉角色第一反应的中景。3.【动作/发现】：用有冲击力的角度表现关键动作或发现。4.【情绪特写】：突出角色情绪的特写。5.【转折点】：改变故事走向的戏剧性时刻。6.【结局】：收束叙事的最终揭示。要求：角色连贯——各格中脸、发型、服装、比例保持一致；风格——干净的动漫分镜、专业分格布局；约束——每格只有一个清晰动作、尽量少对白、背景不杂乱。这样分镜才有导演意图而不是随机拼凑，并保持焦点与连贯。
prompt_en:
Act as a storyboard artist. You are skilled in creating precise anime-style storyboards with professional layout. Your task is to create a 6-panel storyboard page with specific story beats:

**Panels:**
1. **${opening_shot}:** A wide establishing shot to set the scene.
2. **${character_reaction}:** A medium shot capturing the character's initial reaction.
3. **[Action/Discovery]:** A dynamic angle showing a key action or discovery.
4. **[Emotional Close-Up]:** A close-up to highlight the character's emotions.
5. **${turning_point}:** A dramatic moment that shifts the story.
6. **${resolution}:** A final reveal that concludes the narrative.

**Guidelines:**
- **Character Continuity:** Maintain the same face, hair, outfit, proportions throughout the panels.
- **Style:** Ensure a clean anime storyboard with a professional panel layout.
- **Constraints:** One clear action per panel, minimal dialogue, and no background clutter.

This ensures the storyboard is well-directed and not random, maintaining focus and continuity.

prompt_zh: 镜号｜时长｜景别｜运镜｜画面内容｜人物动作｜台词/音效｜转场。示例：3｜2秒｜近景｜缓推｜女主看手机｜手指停住、瞳孔放大｜手机震动声｜硬切。
prompt_en: Shot # | duration | shot size | camera move | content | action | dialogue/SFX | transition. Example: 3 | 2s | close shot | slow push | heroine reads her phone | finger freezes, pupils widen | phone buzz | hard cut.

title.zh: 分镜时序·三镜头 5 秒

prompt_zh: 镜头1（0-1.5秒）：【景别】【画面内容】；镜头2（1.5-3.5秒）：【景别】【动作】；镜头3（3.5-5秒）：【景别】【结果/反应】。每个镜头一个动作，镜头之间人物、服装、场景保持一致。
prompt_en: Shot 1 (0-1.5s): [shot size] [content]; Shot 2 (1.5-3.5s): [shot size] [action]; Shot 3 (3.5-5s): [shot size] [result/reaction]. One action per shot; keep characters, costumes and setting consistent across shots.

prompt_zh: 镜头1（0-2秒）：过肩镜头，女主说「你早就知道了？」；镜头2（2-4秒）：反打男主近景，他沉默地移开目光；镜头3（4-5秒）：女主近景，眼眶泛红。办公室，傍晚窗光。
prompt_en: Shot 1 (0-2s): over-the-shoulder, she says, "You knew all along?" Shot 2 (2-4s): reverse close shot of him silently looking away. Shot 3 (4-5s): her close-up, eyes reddening. Office, late-afternoon window light.

title.zh: 分镜时序·10 秒动作段落

prompt_zh: 镜头1（0-2秒）：全景，男主推开仓库大门；镜头2（2-4秒）：中景，三名打手转身围上；镜头3（4-7秒）：跟拍，男主连续格挡两人；镜头4（7-9秒）：慢动作，第三人被踢飞撞上纸箱；镜头5（9-10秒）：近景，男主整理袖口。
prompt_en: Shot 1 (0-2s): wide, the lead pushes open the warehouse door. Shot 2 (2-4s): medium, three thugs turn and close in. Shot 3 (4-7s): tracking, he blocks two of them in succession. Shot 4 (7-9s): slow motion, the third is kicked into a stack of boxes. Shot 5 (9-10s): close-up, he straightens his cuffs.

prompt_zh: 镜头A：小女孩吹灭生日蜡烛的特写；镜头B：同样构图，成年后的她在空荡的公寓里吹灭一支蜡烛。两个镜头的构图、位置、动作完全对齐，用硬切连接，表现时间流逝。
prompt_en: Shot A: close-up of a little girl blowing out birthday candles. Shot B: same framing, the grown woman blowing out a single candle in an empty apartment. Composition, position and action align exactly; join with a hard cut to show time passing.

prompt_zh: 两条线交替：A 线女主在婚礼现场等待（镜头越来越近）；B 线男主在堵车的路上焦急看表（镜头越来越快）。每个镜头 1–2 秒交替，直到两条线在教堂门口汇合。
prompt_en: Two lines intercut: line A, the heroine waiting at the wedding (shots getting tighter); line B, the hero stuck in traffic checking his watch (shots getting faster). Alternate every 1-2 seconds until both lines meet at the church doors.

prompt_zh: 左右分屏：左侧是满是油污的灶台，右侧是同一灶台被 [产品] 擦拭后光亮如新；中间一条竖线从左向右扫过，扫过的地方从脏变干净。俯拍，明亮冷白光。不夸大效果。
prompt_en: Split screen: a greasy stovetop on the left, the same stovetop gleaming after the [product] on the right; a vertical line sweeps left to right, turning everything it passes clean. Overhead, bright cool-white light. Don't exaggerate the effect.

title.zh: 隔夜咖啡 → 新鲜一杯（前后对比）

prompt_zh: 早上 7 点的书桌，9:16。一杯昨天剩下的冷咖啡放在灰扑扑的办公室平光里——表面结了一层膜，没有热气，毫无生气。[0-2秒] 缓慢推近那层浑浊的表面，未调色、死气沉沉，灰尘悬在静止的空气里。[2-4秒] 一只手把这杯拿出画面，[品牌] 的新鲜咖啡以微距倾注而下：深色水柱冲进杯中，粉层膨胀翻卷，金色窗光斜扫过表面。[4-6秒] 蒸汽在体积逆光中盘旋，油脂紧密地慢速旋转，前景虚化里是清晰的烘焙豆；调色转为温暖、饱和、诱人。液体物理全程一致，杯子的形状、杯沿和把手完全不变——不扭曲、不融化、液位不漂移、表面无瑕疵。暗示音效：轻柔的倾倒声，第一口满足的啜饮。
prompt_en: 7am desk, 9:16. A cold mug of yesterday's coffee sits in flat gray office light — a dull skin on the surface, no steam, no life. [0-2s] slow dolly-in on that scummy surface, ungraded and lifeless, dust hanging in the still air. [2-4s] a hand lifts the dead mug out of frame and a fresh pour from [brand] streams down in macro: the dark jet hits the cup, the bloom rises and folds, golden window light raking across it. [4-6s] steam curls in volumetric backlight, crema swirling in a tight slow rotation, roasted beans crisp in foreground bokeh; the grade pushes warm, saturated, appetizing. Liquid physics stay consistent throughout, the cup keeps its exact shape, rim, and handle — no warping, melting, level-drift, or surface artifacts. Implied sound: a quiet pour, the first satisfied sip.

title.zh: 暗沉肌 → 水光肌（微距对比）

prompt_zh: 极致美妆微距，9:16。清晨冷光下的一侧脸颊——皮肤疲惫干燥，表面有细小起皮，毛孔真实，带一点灰绿色调。[0-2秒] 静止微距、浅景深，每一处暗沉纹理都如实呈现，不磨皮。[2-4秒] 指尖按下一颗 [品牌] 精华，在脸颊上滑开；液滴映着光，摊成一层薄膜。[4-7秒] 皮肤转为柔软有弹性的水润状态，细纹舒展，美人碟主光下泛起健康的暖金光泽，眼中有眼神光。[7-8秒] 镜头微微拉远，露出平静、均匀、透亮的肤色。整个镜头中脸部结构、雀斑、骨相完全一致——不过度磨皮成塑料感、不融化、脸部不漂移。暗示音效：指尖轻点皮肤的声音，一声轻柔的呼气。

[0-2s] static macro, shallow focus, every dull texture detail rendered truthfully, no smoothing. [2-4s] a fingertip presses a single pearl of [brand] serum and glides it across the cheek; the droplet catches light and spreads into a thin film. [4-7s] the skin shifts to a soft hydrated bounce, fine lines easing, a healthy warm-gold sheen blooming under a beauty-dish key with a catchlight in the down. [7-8s] a slight pull-back reveals a calm, even, luminous complexion. Same face geometry, same freckles, same bone structure across the whole shot — no plastic over-smoothing, melting, or facial drift. Implied sound: a gentle tap of fingertip on skin, a soft exhale.

[6-8s] slow orbit around the heel, micro-reflections gliding across fresh mesh, ground shadow tight and grounded. Implied sound: a stiff brush sweep, the clean snap of laces pulled tight.

prompt_en: Against a light backdrop the model in the [product] dress turns a slow full circle, hem flaring naturally, then stops facing the camera, lightly lifting the skirt. Locked full-body framing, soft even light, visible fabric texture.

prompt_en: Shot 1: macro of the zipper sliding open. Shot 2: water poured on the fabric beads and rolls off. Shot 3: a finger presses the insole and it springs back. Shot 4: the full product. 1.5s each, showing three selling points of the [product], white background.

prompt_zh: 锅盖掀开的瞬间，大团热气涌出，慢动作中露出红亮的红烧肉，汤汁咕嘟冒泡；筷子夹起一块，肉质颤动，酱汁缓缓滴落。暖色侧逆光，微距。
prompt_en: The lid lifts and a cloud of steam bursts out; in slow motion, glossy red-braised pork is revealed, sauce bubbling. Chopsticks lift a piece that jiggles as glaze drips slowly. Warm side-backlight, macro.

prompt_zh: 透明玻璃杯装满冰块，[产品] 果汁从上方倒入，慢动作中液体冲击冰块溅起水花，气泡沿杯壁上升，杯壁凝结水珠；最后一片柠檬落在杯沿。逆光，背景虚化。
prompt_en: A clear glass full of ice; [product] juice pours in from above, and in slow motion the liquid crashes over the ice, splashing as bubbles rise along the glass and condensation beads on the outside; a lemon slice lands on the rim. Backlit, blurred background.

prompt_zh: 深色石板台面上，一只高高的多棱面高球杯装着冰冷萃，微距英雄镜头。0-2秒：一块冰以慢动作翻落，溅起的水珠悬停在空中，杯壁上新鲜的凝水缓缓爬下；2-4秒：一缕细细的琥珀色 [产品] 冷萃从铜壶倒出，与清水交织，烟雾般的咖啡丝像墨一样向下绽开；4-6秒：镜头缓缓后拉，露出整杯：顶上一层淡色油脂、一枝薄荷、一个压印着 [品牌] 的杯垫。100mm 微距，电动轨道缓慢推进，最后柔和减速停下。单一低位侧窗主光，暖色轮廓光掠过杯沿，阴影深沉。杯子棱面和冰块形状严格不变，液流始终是一个连续整体，不变形、不漂移、不跳帧、无渲染瑕疵。暗示音效：冰块碰撞、轻微气泡声、倾倒的沙沙声。

Single low side-window key, warm rim light skimming the rim, deep crushed shadows. The glass facets and ice hold exact shape, the liquid stream stays one continuous body with no deformation, drift, popping, or rendering artifacts. Implied sound: ice clink, soft fizz, the hush of the pour.

title.zh: 意式浓缩·油脂流体物理

prompt_zh: 一只哑光陶瓷杯放在暖色洞石台面正中，清晨侧窗硬光斜照。0-2秒：俯拍微距，一股浓稠带油脂的浓缩咖啡从抛光冲煮手柄落下，表面绽开虎斑纹油脂，蒸汽升腾。2-3秒：镜头下摇到桌面低角度，金色逆光点亮上升的水汽，背景是深色阴影。3-5秒：绕杯缓慢横移，一块方糖落下，同心涟漪以慢动作在油脂层中扩散。5-8秒：停在四分之三英雄角度，[品牌] 铝箔咖啡袋在后方闪光。液体保持可信的黏稠度，油脂层是连续的一层——不拖影、不重影、水流不断裂、不沸腾翻涌。音效：萃取的咕嘟声、蒸汽嘶声、一声陶瓷轻碰。
prompt_en: A matte ceramic cup sits centered on warm travertine, hard morning side-window light slanting across the scene. 0-2s: top-down macro of a thick crema-rich espresso stream falling from a polished portafilter, the surface blooming into a tiger-striped crema as steam curls off it. 2-3s: tilt to a low table-level angle, golden backlight igniting the rising vapor against deep shadow. 3-5s: a slow lateral truck around the cup as a single sugar cube drops, concentric ripples spreading through the crema in slow motion. 5-8s: settle on a hero three-quarter with the [brand] foil bag glinting behind. Liquid keeps believable viscosity and the crema reads as a continuous skin — no smearing, ghosting, broken-stream artifacts, or boil-up. Sound: gurgle of extraction, hiss of steam, a single ceramic clink.

prompt_zh: 俯拍微距，一只触感细腻的哑光白盒装着 [品牌][产品]（一款补水精华），放在冷灰色河石上。0-2秒：两只拇指按住磁吸盒盖，盒盖带着一声轻柔的气压声抬起，一缕冷雾从冰凉的盒内飘出。2-4秒：磨砂玻璃滴管瓶被笔直地从模切托槽中取出，琥珀色液体以缓慢黏稠的波浪晃动，冰凉的玻璃上凝结水珠、拖出水痕。4-6秒：橡胶滴头被按压，一滴饱满的金色液滴在滴管尖端鼓起、颤动着悬停，然后落下，在黑色镜面上荡开涟漪。顶部柔光箱漫射照明，湿润的高光，轻微的环境底噪，液滴落下时一声湿润的拨弦般声响。瓶子的形状、标签字体和磨砂质感每一帧都保持一致；不变形、不漂移、不融化、不出现重复滴管、文字不扭曲。
prompt_en: Top-down macro on a fingertip-smooth matte-white box for [brand] [product], a hydrating face serum, resting on cool gray riverstone. 0-2s: two thumbs press the magnetic lid, which lifts with a soft pneumatic sigh as a thin ribbon of breath-mist curls out of the cold interior. 2-4s: the frosted glass dropper bottle is drawn straight up out of its die-cut cradle, amber liquid sloshing in slow viscous waves, condensation beading and trailing down the chilled glass. 4-6s: the rubber bulb compresses and one fat golden droplet swells at the pipette tip, hangs trembling, then falls and ripples outward across a black mirror surface. Diffused overhead softbox, dewy specular highlights, faint room tone with a single wet pluck on the droplet impact. The bottle holds a consistent shape, label typography, and frosted finish across every frame; no deformation, drift, melting, duplicate droppers, or warped text.

title.zh: 腕表抽屉开启·上链特写

prompt_zh: 低位四分之三微距，一只漆面胡桃木展示盒装着 [品牌][产品]（一款自动机械表），在深炭灰天鹅绒背景前打暖光。0-2秒：指尖勾住黄铜拉手，绒面抽屉伴着平滑低沉的滑动声打开，露出卧在弧形表枕上的腕表。2-4秒：腕表被取出并倾斜，一道硬主光扫过拉丝钢表壳和太阳纹表盘，一道亮反光在表镜上移动。4-6秒：拇指和食指转动表冠，发出细密的棘轮咔哒声，秒针开始连续顺滑地走动。6-8秒：表带平放，折叠扣以一声精准的金属咔嗒扣上，镜头移焦到刻字表背。氛围感产品布光、丰富的反射、清脆的制表 ASMR。表壳几何、表盘刻度和指针数量每帧一致；不形变、不出现双重指针、刻字不模糊、无瑕疵。
prompt_en: Low three-quarter macro on a lacquered walnut presentation box for [brand] [product], an automatic wristwatch, lit warm against deep charcoal velvet. 0-2s: a fingertip hooks the brass pull and a felt-lined drawer glides open with a smooth low rumble, revealing the watch nested in a curved pillow. 2-4s: the watch is lifted out and tilted so a hard key light sweeps across the brushed steel case and sunburst dial, sending a bright reflection traveling over the crystal. 4-6s: a thumb and forefinger wind the crown with a fine ratcheting tick, the second hand sweeping to life in a continuous glide. 6-8s: the strap is laid flat and the deployant clasp snaps shut with a precise metallic click as the camera racks focus to the engraved caseback. Moody product lighting, rich reflections, crisp horological ASMR. The watch keeps consistent case geometry, dial markings, and hand count across frames; no morphing, doubled hands, smeared engraving, or artifacts.

prompt_zh: 16:9 横屏：开场 5 秒用最高潮的画面 + 一句旁白设问（「如果你醒来发现回到了十年前，你会做的第一件事是什么？」），随后标题卡，再从头讲。B站观众接受更长的铺垫和更完整的故事。
prompt_en: 16:9: open with five seconds of the climax plus a voice-over question ("If you woke up ten years in the past, what would you do first?"), then a title card, then tell it from the start. Bilibili viewers accept longer setup and fuller stories.

title.zh: 抖音·竖屏短剧单集节奏

prompt_zh: 9:16，单集 60–90 秒：0-3秒冲突画面；每 10–15 秒一个小反转或爽点；人物居中构图，字幕区留在画面下三分之一；最后 3 秒给悬念钩子。景别以近景为主，减少大远景。
prompt_en: 9:16, 60-90 seconds per episode: conflict in 0-3s; a small reversal or payoff every 10-15s; center-framed characters with the bottom third reserved for captions; a cliffhanger in the last 3s. Mostly close shots, few extreme wides.

prompt_zh: 结尾让主角面对两个选择（两扇门、两个人、两条消息），画面停在她犹豫的脸上，旁白：「如果是你，你选哪一个？」引导观众讨论，而不是要求点赞。
prompt_en: End with the protagonist facing two choices (two doors, two people, two messages), hold on her hesitating face, voice-over: "Which would you choose?" Invite discussion rather than asking for likes.

prompt_zh: 9:16 竖屏：人物面部放在画面上方 1/3 到中间之间；底部 20% 留给字幕和平台按钮，右侧 15% 避开点赞评论按钮；重要道具不要放在边缘。提示词可写「人物居中偏上，下方留空」。
prompt_en: In 9:16, place faces between the upper third and the middle; keep the bottom 20% for captions and platform UI and avoid the right 15% where like/comment buttons sit; keep key props off the edges. Prompt with "subject centered slightly high, empty space below."

prompt_zh: 同一场戏要同时出横屏和竖屏时，生成时让主体始终位于画面中央 1/3 宽度内，背景两侧留出可裁切空间；双人戏改为正反打而不是双人同框。
prompt_en: When one scene needs both landscape and vertical versions, keep the subject within the central third of the width and leave croppable space on both sides; for two-person scenes use shot-reverse-shot instead of a two-shot.

title.zh: 平台爆款结构写法要点

prompt_zh: 先确定平台（比例、时长、观众习惯），再套结构：钩子（前 3 秒）→ 铺垫 → 升级 → 反转 → 悬念。同一个故事在不同平台改的是节奏和比例，不是故事本身。
prompt_en: Decide the platform first (aspect ratio, length, viewer habits), then apply the structure: hook (first 3s) → setup → escalation → reversal → cliffhanger. Across platforms you change rhythm and ratio, not the story.

prompt_zh: 每集开头用同一个 1 秒画面（同一场景、同一构图、同一音效），比如女主推开公司大门的固定镜头，再接本集内容。固定元素帮助观众在信息流中认出你的剧。
prompt_en: Open every episode with the same one-second shot (same set, framing and sound)—say, the heroine pushing open the company doors—then go into the episode. A fixed element helps viewers recognize your series in the feed.

title.zh: 竖屏短剧·付费卡点设计
title.en: Vertical drama: designing the paywall moment

prompt_zh: 连载短剧的关键卡点放在第 8–12 集：主角的身份或秘密即将揭开的前一秒（对方张口要说出名字、信封正要拆开）。卡点前一集要把期待值拉满，卡点那一刻直接黑屏。
prompt_en: In serialized drama, put the key cliffhanger around episodes 8-12: the second before the protagonist's identity or secret is revealed (someone about to say the name, an envelope about to be opened). Build expectation in the prior episode and cut to black at that instant.

prompt_zh: 最后一帧的构图和动作设计成能无缝接回第一帧：例如开头她推门进来，结尾她走到门口准备推门。观众不知不觉看第二遍。
prompt_en: Design the last frame's composition and action to flow seamlessly back into the first: she pushes the door open at the start, and at the end walks up to the door about to push it. Viewers rewatch without noticing.

prompt_zh: 面向海外短视频平台：用动作和表情讲故事，尽量少依赖台词；前 1 秒给强视觉冲击；画面中文字用英文或不放文字；时长 15–30 秒，结尾可循环接回开头。
prompt_en: For overseas short-video platforms: tell the story through action and expression with minimal dialogue; strong visual impact in the first second; on-screen text in English or none; 15-30 seconds, with an ending that loops back to the start.

title.zh: 小红书·氛围感 vlog 结构

prompt_zh: 3:4 或 9:16：开头 1 秒成品/结果画面 → 2–5 个氛围感细节镜头（手部、光影、物件）→ 过程 → 结尾回到成品并留一句提问。色调统一偏暖或偏奶油色，节奏舒缓。
prompt_en: 3:4 or 9:16: open with one second of the finished result → two to five aesthetic detail shots (hands, light, objects) → the process → return to the result and end with a question. Consistent warm or creamy palette, relaxed pacing.

prompt_zh: 情绪最高点把所有音乐和环境声抽掉，只留一个细小的声音（心跳、钟表、呼吸）2–3 秒，然后音乐重新进入。比一直铺满音乐更有冲击力。
prompt_en: At the emotional peak, strip out all music and ambience and leave one small sound (heartbeat, clock, breath) for two to three seconds before the music returns. More impact than wall-to-wall score.

prompt_zh: 下一场的声音提前 1 秒进入（J-cut）：画面还是女主在办公室发呆，已经听到婚礼进行曲，随后切到婚礼现场。让转场更流畅、更有悬念。
prompt_en: Bring the next scene's sound in one second early (J-cut): we're still on the heroine zoning out at the office when the wedding march begins, then cut to the wedding. Smoother, more suspenseful transitions.

prompt_zh: 台词用引号单独写出，并注明说话人和语气：女主（压低声音，带着颤抖）说：「你骗了我整整三年。」一个镜头只放一句短台词，长度控制在 3 秒内，口型更容易对上。
prompt_en: Put dialogue in quotes and name the speaker and tone: the heroine (low, trembling voice) says, "You lied to me for three whole years." One short line per shot, under three seconds, for better lip sync.

prompt_zh: 常用语气标注：冷笑着、咬牙切齿、哽咽、轻描淡写、压低声音、几乎是喊出来、带着笑意、一字一顿、不耐烦地、颤抖着。配音或口型生成时把标注放在台词前面。
prompt_en: Useful tone tags: with a cold laugh, through gritted teeth, choking up, offhandedly, in a low voice, almost shouting, smiling, word by word, impatiently, trembling. Put the tag before the line for voice or lip-sync generation.

title.en: Sound: the voice on the phone

prompt_zh: 电话里的声音做「电话滤波」处理：频率变窄、略带电流声；画面只拍接电话的人，对方声音冷静地说：「你女儿在我这里。」接电话的人手里的杯子滑落。
prompt_en: Process the caller's voice with a telephone filter—narrow frequency, a little line hiss; show only the person answering as the voice says calmly, "Your daughter is with me." The cup slips from the listener's hand.

prompt_zh: 支持音视频联合生成的模型（如 Seedance 2.x、Veo 3）可以在提示词末尾单独写一段「声音：」，包括对白、音效、环境声和音乐；不支持的模型就把声音留给配音和剪辑阶段处理，避免干扰画面生成。
prompt_en: For models that generate audio with video (e.g., Seedance 2.x, Veo 3), add a separate "Sound:" section at the end covering dialogue, SFX, ambience and music. For models without audio, leave sound to the voice and edit stages so it doesn't distract the image generation.

prompt_zh: 配乐用「情绪+乐器+节奏」描述：紧张——低音弦乐持续音、渐强鼓点；甜宠——轻快钢琴、拨弦、口哨；悲伤——慢速大提琴独奏；爽点——电子鼓点骤起、重低音落点。
prompt_en: Describe music as mood + instruments + tempo: tension—sustained low strings, building drums; sweet romance—light piano, pizzicato, whistling; sadness—slow solo cello; payoff—sudden electronic beat, heavy bass drop.

title.zh: 音画同步·关键动作卡点
title.en: Sync key actions to the beat

prompt_zh: 把关键动作（摔门、耳光、转身、抬眼）放在音乐重拍上；生成时在提示词里写「动作发生在第 2 秒和第 4 秒」，剪辑时对齐鼓点。
prompt_en: Land key actions (door slam, slap, turn, eyes lifting) on the music's downbeats; prompt "the action happens at second 2 and second 4," then align to the drum hits in the edit.

prompt_zh: 环境声分三层写：底层（雨声、城市低鸣）、中层（脚步、关门、杯碟）、点缀（远处狗叫、一声汽车喇叭）。示例：雨夜小巷，持续的雨声，积水中的脚步声，远处偶尔一声警笛。
prompt_en: Layer ambience in three: bed (rain, city hum), mid (footsteps, doors, dishes), accents (a distant dog, one car horn). Example: rainy alley at night—steady rain, footsteps in puddles, an occasional distant siren.

prompt_zh: 打斗音效按动作写：出拳——短促破风声；命中——闷响加衣料摩擦；格挡——手臂相撞的硬响；倒地——身体撞地加尘土声；武器——金属碰撞的清脆回响。
prompt_en: Write fight SFX per action: punch—short whoosh; hit—dull thud plus cloth rustle; block—hard clack of forearms; fall—body hitting the floor with dust; weapons—bright metallic ring.

title.zh: 旁白·第一人称内心独白

prompt_zh: 旁白语气平静、语速偏慢、贴近麦克风的气声：「那天我才知道，原来他口中的『出差』，是去见另一个人。」画面配女主独自坐在车里的近景。
prompt_en: Calm, slightly slow, close-mic breathy voice-over: "That day I finally learned his 'business trips' meant seeing someone else." Paired with a close shot of the heroine alone in her car.

prompt_zh: 人体结构正确，五指清晰，四肢完整，无多余手指，无多余肢体，无肢体融合，面部不变形。
prompt_en: correct anatomy, five distinct fingers, complete limbs, no extra fingers, no extra limbs, no fused limbs, no facial distortion.

prompt_zh: 单一连续镜头，不切换镜头，不跳切，机位保持稳定。适用于需要一镜到底或固定机位的生成。
prompt_en: single continuous shot, no cuts, no jump cuts, stable camera position. For generations that need one take or a locked-off camera.

prompt_zh: 人物面部、发型、服装在全片保持一致，不换脸，不突变，场景与道具位置保持不变。
prompt_en: character face, hairstyle and outfit stay consistent throughout, no identity change, no sudden morphing, set and props stay in place.

prompt_zh: 9:16 竖屏构图，主体居中，头部不被裁切，下方留出字幕空间，不要横屏画面加黑边。
prompt_en: 9:16 vertical composition, subject centered, head not cropped, space below for captions, no letterboxed landscape footage.

prompt_zh: 无字幕，无文字，无水印，无 Logo，无边框，画面干净。
prompt_en: no subtitles, no text, no watermark, no logo, no borders, clean frame.

prompt_zh: 不支持负面提示词输入框的模型，把约束直接写在提示词末尾，用肯定句更有效（「五指清晰」优于「不要多手指」）；约束不超过 5 条，太多反而稀释主体描述。
prompt_en: For models without a negative-prompt field, put constraints at the end of the prompt; positive phrasing works better ("five distinct fingers" beats "no extra fingers"). Keep it to five constraints or fewer—too many dilute the main description.

prompt_zh: 动作连贯自然，无闪烁，无抖动跳帧，无画面撕裂，物体不凭空出现或消失，镜头运动平滑。
prompt_en: smooth natural motion, no flicker, no jitter or dropped frames, no tearing, objects don't appear or vanish, smooth camera movement.

title.en: Constraint: no anachronisms in period pieces

prompt_zh: 古代场景，不出现现代物品（手机、电线、塑料、眼镜、手表、汽车），服装与发型符合古装设定。
prompt_en: Period setting, no modern objects (phones, power lines, plastic, eyeglasses, wristwatches, cars), costumes and hairstyles appropriate to the era.

prompt_zh: 产品形状、比例、颜色和标签文字保持一致，不变形，不融化，标签文字不扭曲，不出现其他品牌标志。
prompt_en: product shape, proportions, color and label text stay consistent, no deformation, no melting, no warped label text, no other brand logos.

prompt_zh: 高清，细节清晰，无模糊，无噪点，无压缩伪影，无过曝，无欠曝。
prompt_en: high definition, crisp detail, no blur, no noise, no compression artifacts, no overexposure, no underexposure.

prompt_zh: 无血腥，无暴露，衣着得体，不出现真实名人，不出现武器特写（动作戏用拳脚或道具剑），符合平台内容规范。
prompt_en: no gore, no nudity, modest clothing, no real celebrities, no close-ups of firearms (use fists or prop swords in action scenes), compliant with platform content rules.

prompt_zh: 写实风格，不要卡通，不要动漫，不要过度磨皮，不要塑料质感，不要过饱和。
prompt_en: realistic style, not cartoon, not anime, no over-smoothed skin, no plastic look, not oversaturated.
